en: Michel Bitbol, Pierre Kerszberg, and Jean Petitot
zh: 米歇尔·比托尔、皮埃尔·凯尔茨贝格、让·珀蒂托

en: An appropriate starting point for this introduction consists in providing the reader with a short definition of the adjectives “transcendent” and “transcendental”. All too often, these adjectives are mixed up (especially in the English-speaking philosophical tradition), and this leads to many misunderstandings. In a book entirely devoted to transcendental epistemology and its applications to physics, such misunderstandings could easily blur how each idea is perceived. This is why we must try to avoid them from the outset.
zh: 这篇导论的一个恰当起点，是向读者提供“超验的”（transcendent）与“先验的”（transcendental）这两个形容词的简短定义。这两个词太常被混为一谈（尤其是在英语哲学传统中），由此导致许多误解。在一本完全致力于先验认识论及其在物理学中应用的书里，这类误解很容易模糊人们对每个观念的理解。这正是我们必须从一开始就设法避免它们的原因。

en: “Transcendent” and “transcendental” somehow point towards opposite directions. True, both words share a common component of meaning, which is “exceeding experience”. But “exceeding” can be achieved in two antithetical ways. A transcendent object exceeds experience insofar as it allegedly exists beyond experience, as a remote (and intellectually reconstructed) external cause of experienced phenomena. By contrast, a transcendental structure exceeds experience because it is a background precondition of experience. Since transcendental structures concern the methods of access to experience, they have been thought of as pertaining to the subject of this experience by the classical tradition. But the latter notion of subject has nothing to do with psychology; it can rather be construed as a precursor of the cognitive notion of “access consciousness” in the sense of Ned Block. So, a transcendent object is supposed to wait for us “out there”, and is indifferent to our intervention. By contrast, transcendental preconditions prescribe rules of active definition and selection of phenomena in such a way that one may consider them as if they were appearances of an object. This is the difference between merely believing in the existence of objects, and being aware of the procedure through which we constitute them. This also accounts for the difference between an ordinary and a critical definition of objectivity: objectivity in the first sense refers to that which possesses transcendent being; whereas objectivity in the second sense refers to what can be made valid for any one of us, independently of our situation, but not independently of the fact of being situated.
zh: “超验的”与“先验的”在某种意义上指向相反的方向。诚然，两个词共享一个共同的意义成分，即“超出经验”。但“超出”可以通过两种对立的方式实现。一个超验对象超出经验，是因为它据称存在于经验之外，作为被经验到的现象的某种遥远的（并且在理智上重构出来的）外部原因。与之相反，一个先验结构超出经验，是因为它是经验的背景性前提条件。由于先验结构关涉通达经验的方法，古典传统一直认为它们属于这种经验的主体。但后一种主体概念与心理学毫无关系；它毋宁可以被理解为内德·布洛克（Ned Block）意义上“通达意识”这一认知概念的先驱。因此，超验对象被设想为在“外面某处”等待着我们，对我们的干预漠不关心。与之相反，先验前提条件为现象的主动定义与选择规定规则，其方式使我们可以把这些现象看作仿佛是某个对象的显象。这就是仅仅相信对象存在，与意识到我们借以构成对象的程序之间的区别。这也解释了客观性的通常定义与批判性定义之间的差别：第一种意义上的客观性指涉拥有超验存在的东西；而第二种意义上的客观性指涉能够对我们中的任何一个人都有效、不依赖于我们的处境、但并不脱离“有所处境”这一事实的东西。

en: Kant was the primary source of the distinction we have just stressed between “transcendent” and “transcendental”. The contrast develops thus:
zh: 我们刚刚强调的“超验的”与“先验的”之别，其首要来源是康德。这一对照展开如下：

en: (…) As soon as we posit the unconditioned (…) in what is entirely outside the world of sense and hence outside all possible experience, the ideas become transcendent”.
“I call transcendental all cognition that deals not so much with objects as rather with our way of cognizing objects in general insofar as that way of cognizing is to be possible a priori.
zh: “（……）一旦我们把无条件者（……）设定在完全处于感官世界之外、因而处于一切可能经验之外的东西之中，理念就变成超验的了。”
“我把一切并不着重研究对象，而是研究我们认识对象的一般方式的知识，称为先验的，只要这种认识方式应当是先天可能的。”

en: Despite this clear distinction, Kant’s own use of the word “transcendental” is sometimes misleading. This is the case when he writes e.g. the expression “transcendental realism”, which could roughly be interpreted as “transcendent realism”. The reason why he still uses the word “transcendental” instead of “transcendent” in this context is that he wishes to make a distinction between two misuses of our intelligence. The fist misuse consists in extrapolating the application of the principles or categories of pure understanding (a major component of the transcendental preconditions of knowledge) beyond the limits of possible experience; it gives rise to what Kant calls “transcendental illusion”. The second misuse consists in manipulating entirely new speculative principles “(…) requiring us to tear down all these boundary posts”
; it gives rise to the representation of fake transcendent realms.
zh: 尽管有这一清楚的区分，康德本人对“先验的”一词的使用有时却令人困惑。例如当他写下“先验实在论”这一表述时，情况便是如此——它可以大致被解读为“超验实在论”。他在此语境中仍使用“先验的”而非“超验的”，原因在于他希望区分我们理智的两种误用。第一种误用在于把纯粹知性的原理或范畴（知识的先验前提条件的主要成分）的应用外推到可能经验的界限之外；它产生康德所谓的“先验幻相”。第二种误用在于运用全新的思辨原理，“（……）要求我们拆毁所有这些界碑”
；它产生虚假超验领域的表象。

en: To recapitulate, “transcendent” connotes an attempt at breaking up the limits of experience, whereas “transcendental” refers to a reflective move in which one examines the (subjective) conditions of possibility of this experience. “Transcendent” points towards the farthest, whereas “transcendental” brings us back to the closest (which is usually inapparent due to its being too close). Accordingly, elaborating a transcendental epistemology of physics does not mean looking for hidden entities beyond empirical knowledge, but rather undertaking a reflective research about the indispensible preconditions of our knowledge and their relevance to the structure of physical theories.
zh: 概括地说，“超验的”意味着一种突破经验界限的尝试，而“先验的”则指一种反思的转向，借此考察这种经验的（主体方面的）可能性条件。“超验的”指向最远处，而“先验的”把我们带回最近处（后者通常恰恰因为太近而不显眼）。相应地，构建一种物理学的先验认识论，并不意味着在经验知识之外寻找隐藏的实体，而是着手一项反思性研究，考察我们知识不可或缺的前提条件及其与物理理论结构的相关性。

en: 1 Bringing Transcendental Epistemology Back to Life
zh: 1 让先验认识论重获生机

en: As indicated in the title, this book concerns transcendental approaches of modern physics. This may seem surprising as it has become commonplace to assume that transcendentalism has been invalidated by the successive developments of physics after Newton. Most philosophers of science think that “transcendental” and “modern physics” are two terms which have long since become incompatible. Their idea is that the limits of Kant’s philosophy of science indicate the limits of critical philosophy. One may counter this strong prejudice by mentioning three points.
zh: 如书名所示，本书关注现代物理学的先验进路。这看上去也许令人惊讶，因为人们已习以为常地假定：先验论已被牛顿之后物理学的接连发展所否证。大多数科学哲学家认为，“先验的”与“现代物理学”是两个早已互不相容的词。他们的想法是，康德科学哲学的界限标志着批判哲学的界限。针对这一强烈的成见，可以提出三点反驳。

en: (i) As indicated by the title, the central problem of this book is the constitution of objectivity.
zh: （i）如书名所示，本书的中心问题是客观性的构成。

en:
(ii) Transcendental approaches therefore intervene as a general philosophy of constitution, not as a special inventory of fixed mental «faculties».
(iii) There is no reason which prevents us from thinking that, in this respect, transcendentalism can be generalized far beyond its kantian version, even if updating it means distancing oneself from a literal reading of Kant. Kant initiated an approach which has many more resources than those he himself developed.
zh:
（ii）因此，先验进路是作为一种一般的构成哲学而介入的，而不是作为一份固定的心灵“官能”的特殊清单。
（iii）没有任何理由阻止我们认为：在这方面，先验论可以远远超出其康德版本而被推广，即便更新它意味着与对康德的字面解读拉开距离。康德开创的进路所蕴含的资源，远多于他本人所发挥出来的。

en: In the same way as the original version of empiricism which came about during the Scottish enlightenment has been generalized and deepened to a considerable extent, well beyond what its founders had envisaged, by modern epistemologies such as the logical empiricism of the Vienna circle or Bas van Fraassen’s constructive empiricism, the original version of transcendentalism formulated by critical rationalism can also be generalized and deepened to a considerable extent, well beyond what its founder was able to imagine. True, according to some researchers, this distancing strategy distorts the Kantian perspective so much that it no long deserves the name “transcendental”. This pushed them to espouse the advances of physics against a philosophy which nevertheless offers the best epistemology of classical mechanics. But, as this book aims to show, adapting transcendentalism is much more fruitful than rejecting it; and such an adaptation turns out to be very faithful to its Kantian sources, in its spirit and even sometimes in its letter.
zh: 正如苏格兰启蒙运动中产生的经验论原初版本，已被维也纳学派的逻辑经验论或巴斯·范·弗拉森（Bas van Fraassen）的建构经验论等现代认识论大大推广和深化，远远超出其奠基者所设想的范围；批判理性论所表述的先验论原初版本，同样可以被大大推广和深化，远远超出其奠基者所能想象的范围。诚然，在一些研究者看来，这种拉开距离的策略把康德视角扭曲到了不再配称“先验的”的地步。这促使他们拥抱物理学的进展，转而反对一种其实为经典力学提供了最佳认识论的哲学。但正如本书旨在表明的，改造先验论远比拒斥它更富成效；而且这种改造在精神上、有时甚至在字面上，都被证明对其康德源头非常忠实。

en: As it is well known, the transcendental question arises as soon as one realizes that the central and specific epistemological problem of physics is that of mathematical physics. Indeed, fundamental equations are able to generate myriads of precise mathematical models of the variety of observable phenomena, out of universal principles and general concepts. One can express this by saying that these models realize a “computational synthesis” of phenomena. This is a modern form of what Kant called “mathematical construction”, when he pointed out in his time (see Prolegomena, AK, IV, 272) that Hume empiricism tended to underrate the problem of mathematics.
zh: 众所周知，一旦人们意识到物理学核心而独特的认识论问题是数学物理学的问题，先验问题便随之出现。的确，基本方程能够从普遍原理和一般概念出发，为形形色色的可观察现象生成无数精确的数学模型。可以这样表述：这些模型实现了现象的一种“计算综合”。这是康德所谓“数学构造”的现代形式——他在其时代就曾指出（见《未来形而上学导论》，科学院版全集第四卷，第272页），休谟式经验论倾向于低估数学问题。

en: Actually, there exists a radical contrast between conceptual abstraction (which is a subject for an Analytic) and computational synthesis; a contrast that can be seen as regarding the difference between a direct problem and a reverse problem. The direct problem consists in abstracting from the manifold of intuition; it consists in “subordinating” this manifold to what Kant called “the unity of a concept” and what we would call today a categorizing concept. By contrast, the reverse problem consists in constructing the referents of concepts by transforming conceptual contents into algorithms for computing these referents. The reverse problem starts from concepts and points towards the manifold of intuition, not the other way around. Mathematics, helped today by methods of numerical simulation, are the essential tool of computational synthesis.
zh: 实际上，概念抽象（这是分析论的课题）与计算综合之间存在一种根本对照；这种对照可以看作正问题与反问题之间的差别。正问题在于从直观杂多中进行抽象；它在于把这一杂多“归摄”于康德所谓“一个概念的统一性”、也就是我们今天所说的进行范畴化的概念之下。与之相反，反问题在于通过把概念内容转化为计算概念指称对象的算法，来构造这些指称对象。反问题从概念出发，指向直观杂多，而不是相反。数学——如今还借助数值模拟方法——是计算综合的基本工具。

en: The mere fact that physics involves a computational synthesis of observable phenomena means that physical objectivity cannot be tantamount to an ontology of some independent substantial reality. Indeed, the possibility of a mathematical reconstruction of such an ontological reality would ascribe the human mind excessive intellectual capacities which transcend its finiteness. This leaves only two options:
zh: 物理学包含对可观察现象的计算综合这一事实本身，就意味着物理客观性不可能等同于关于某种独立的实体性实在的本体论。的确，对这样一种本体论实在进行数学重构的可能性，将赋予人类心灵超出其有限性的过度理智能力。于是只剩下两个选项：

en:
(a) Physics is purely descriptive. It conceptually organizes the empirical manifold by means of an Analytic, and it can thereby pretend it describes an ontological independent reality, but without reconstructing this reality mathematically and without doing any job other than picturing it passively (empiricism + nominalism).
(b) Physics can reconstruct the empirical manifold mathematically, and it must then accept to partake of a “weak” form of objectivity which de jure can only concern relations between observable phenomena, namely a reality filtered by ineliminable conditions of experimental or sensory accessibility, and by intellectual criteria of selection. The condition of possibility of computational synthesis is the principle of restriction of physical knowledge to laws of observables, and the decoupling between a “strong” ontology and a “weak” objectivity.
zh:
（a）物理学是纯描述性的。它借助一种分析论在概念上组织经验杂多，从而可以声称自己描述了一种本体论上独立的实在，但并不在数学上重构这一实在，除了被动地描画它之外不做任何别的工作（经验论＋唯名论）。
（b）物理学能够在数学上重构经验杂多，但这时它必须接受一种“弱”形式的客观性——这种客观性原则上只能关涉可观察现象之间的关系，也就是一种被不可消除的实验或感官可通达性条件、以及理智的选择标准所过滤的实在。计算综合的可能性条件，是把物理知识限定于可观察量之规律的原则，以及“强”本体论与“弱”客观性之间的脱钩。

en: The general assumption of this book is that modern physics is dominated by the second attitude, and that it raises an increasing number of questions on the processes of constitution of objects connected with the mathematization of observable data. In our opinion, the term “transcendental” essentially refers to that concern. The use of this term is still justified insofar as it can be shown (see Section 3 of this introduction) that appropriate extensions of Kant’s transcendentalism push most of the apparently definitive criticisms which had been formulated against it in the name of the “revolutions” represented by General Relativity and Quantum Mechanics to obsolescence.
zh: 本书的总体假定是：现代物理学由第二种态度主导，并且它就与可观察数据的数学化相联系的对象构成过程提出了越来越多的问题。在我们看来，“先验的”一词本质上指的就是这一关切。只要能够表明（见本导论第3节），对康德先验论的适当扩展，能使那些以广义相对论和量子力学所代表的“革命”之名对它提出的、看似定论性的大多数批评归于过时，那么继续使用这个词就仍然是有正当理由的。

en: This introduction is not the right place to develop the basis of the physical transcendentalism which generalizes Kant’s analysis of newtonian mechanics in the Metaphysische Anfangsgründe der Naturwissenschaft (Metaphysical Foundations of Natural Science, abbrevieted by MFNS, Kant, 1786). Yet, it is useful to think of it as a generic model for other transcendental readings of mathematical physics. We will therefore outline it by enumerating the following points:
zh: 这篇导论不是展开物理先验论之基础的合适场所——这种物理先验论推广了康德在《自然科学的形而上学初始根据》（Metaphysische Anfangsgründe der Naturwissenschaft，即 Metaphysical Foundations of Natural Science，缩写为 MFNS，康德，1786年）中对牛顿力学的分析。不过，把它当作对数学物理学进行其他先验解读的一个通用模型来思考，是有益的。因此我们将通过列举以下几点来勾勒它：

en:
1. Mathematical physics is an objective theory of observable phenomena. The conditions of observability are therefore constitutive of the very concept of a physical object. Since the concept of a phenomenon is relational, namely relative to structures of accessibility, to conditions of observations and to measurement results, physical objectivity cannot de jure bear on an independent reality. Due to its principle of reduction to observable phenomena, physical objectivity cannot, here again, be an ontology but only a “weak” objectivity.
2. Although it is non-ontological, physical objectivity is not naively subjective-relative either. This is due to the fact that it consists in an act of universal legalization of phenomena. It expresses a prescriptive law-like order which imposes a norm onto any description of phenomena.
3. Prescribing a law-like order imposes using an apparently paradoxical procedure. This procedure must indeed take the conditions of accessibility to observables into account, but without including the theory of instruments of observation into the theory of physical objects.
4. The categories and principles of physical objectivity - “system”, “state”, “property”, “causality”, “interaction”, etc. – must then be interpreted mathematically according to the former points. They are not ontological categories, they are prescriptive rather than descriptive, and they incorporate their conditions of accessibility.
zh:
1. 数学物理学是关于可观察现象的客观理论。因此，可观察性条件对于物理对象概念本身具有构成性。由于现象概念是关系性的，即相对于可通达性结构、观察条件和测量结果而言的，物理客观性原则上不能关涉独立的实在。由于其还原到可观察现象的原则，物理客观性在这里同样不可能是一种本体论，而只能是一种“弱”客观性。
2. 尽管是非本体论的，物理客观性也不是朴素的主观—相对的东西。这是由于它在于为现象确立普遍适用的规律。它表达一种规定性的、合乎规律的秩序，把一种规范加于对现象的任何描述之上。
3. 规定这种合乎规律的秩序，要求采用一种表面上悖谬的程序。这一程序确实必须考虑可观察量的可通达性条件，但又不能把观察仪器的理论纳入物理对象的理论之中。
4. 于是，物理客观性的范畴和原理——“系统”“状态”“性质”“因果性”“相互作用”等等——必须按照前几点在数学上加以解释。它们不是本体论范畴，它们是规定性的而非描述性的，并且内在地包含其可通达性条件。

en: In classical mechanics as interpreted by Kant in MFNS, point (1) is expressed by the reduction of the scope of physics to sensory phenomena, point (2) is expressed by the Analytic of concepts, point (3) is expressed by the transcendental Aesthetic which explains why mechanics consists of a differential geometry of motions in space–time, and point (4) is expressed by the procedure of schematism, or the construction of categories. But there is no reason to restrict this transcendental analysis to classical mechanics. In quantum mechanics, for instance, one can consider that: point (1) is expressed by Heisenberg’s reduction to observables, point (2) remains a transcendental Analytic, but with some alterations, point (3) corresponds to probability amplitudes and operator algebras in Hilbert spaces of states, and point (4) is a reinterpretation of the categorial Analytic in this new framework.
zh: 在康德于 MFNS 中所解释的经典力学里，第（1）点表现为把物理学的范围限定在感官现象之内，第（2）点表现为概念分析论，第（3）点表现为先验感性论——它解释了力学为什么由时空中的运动的微分几何构成，第（4）点则表现为图型法程序，即范畴的构造。但没有理由把这种先验分析局限于经典力学。例如在量子力学中，可以认为：第（1）点表现为海森堡向可观察量的还原，第（2）点仍是一种先验分析论，但有所改动，第（3）点对应于状态希尔伯特空间中的概率幅与算符代数，第（4）点则是在这一新框架中对范畴分析论的重新解释。

en: In his MFNS, Kant then exposes the following features of classical mechanics, by using a one–one correspondence with his table of categories as described in the Critique of Pure Reason:
zh: 随后，康德在 MFNS 中利用与《纯粹理性批判》所述范畴表的一一对应，展示了经典力学的如下特征：

en: (i) Phoronomy (Kinematics). The measurement of the phenomena of motion is derived from the metric of space–time. In other terms, space as a form of presentation and manifestation of phenomena (conditions of observability = forms of intuition) becomes geometry (what Kant calls “formal intuition”) in the context of physics. Kant discovered that Euclidean space is a background structure for mechanics and that, due to Galilean relativity, this Euclidean structure cannot be dissociated from the principle of inertia (more about this later). The symmetry group of Galilean relativity is therefore expressed philosophically by the transcendental ideality of space. Thus, in his book about Kant’s conception of physics, Jules Vuillemin insists on the phoronomic meaning of the transcendental ideality of space: “It is the principle of phoronomy which offers the true demonstration of transcendental aesthetic (…). It is the relativity of motion which makes the subjectivity of space [its transcendental ideality] transcendentally necessary”.

Kant was the first philosopher who identified – as soon as 1758 with his New Theory of Motion and Rest … (Neuer Lehrbegriff der Bewegung und Ruhe…), and in 1768 with his Ultimate Foundation of the Distinction of the Directions in Space (Von dem ersten Grunde des Unterschiedes der Gegenden im Raume) – the philosophical consequences of the fact that symmetries of space (e.g. chirality) which are irreducibly “non conceptual” exist.
zh: （i）运动学（Phoronomy，即 Kinematics）。运动现象的测量由时空的度规导出。换句话说，空间作为现象的呈现与显现形式（可观察性条件＝直观形式），在物理学语境中成为几何学（康德所谓“形式直观”）。康德发现，欧几里得空间是力学的一种背景结构，而且由于伽利略相对性，这种欧氏结构不可能与惯性原理分离（后文详述）。因此，伽利略相对性的对称群在哲学上由空间的先验观念性来表达。于是，于勒·维耶曼（Jules Vuillemin）在其论述康德物理学观的书中强调空间先验观念性的运动学含义：“正是运动学原理提供了先验感性论的真正证明（……）。正是运动的相对性使空间的主体性［其先验观念性］成为先验上必然的。”

康德是第一位辨认出如下事实之哲学后果的哲学家：存在着不可还原地“非概念的”空间对称性（例如手性）——早在1758年的《运动与静止的新学说……》（Neuer Lehrbegriff der Bewegung und Ruhe…），以及1768年的《论空间中方位区分的最初根据》（Von dem ersten Grunde des Unterschiedes der Gegenden im Raume）中，他就已做到这一点。

en: (ii) Dynamics. Motion is described by means of intensive magnitudes, such as velocities and accelerations (i.e. “moments”). Therefore, mechanics is a priori a differential geometry, and the differential descriptions must be compatible with phoronomic relativity: this is an outline of the concept of covariance. J. Vuillemin also insists on this, and draws a major philosophical conclusion: “that dynamics presupposes phoronomy means the possibility of a Copernican revolution about the concept of substance, a revolution which is likely to be at the heart of Kant’s idealism”.
zh: （ii）动力学。运动借助强度量来描述，例如速度和加速度（即“矩”）。因此，力学先天地是一种微分几何，而微分描述必须与运动学的相对性相容：这就是协变性概念的雏形。维耶曼同样强调这一点，并得出一个重要的哲学结论：“动力学以运动学为前提，意味着关于实体概念的一场哥白尼式革命的可能性，这场革命很可能处于康德观念论的核心。”

en:
(iii) Mechanics. By way of temporal schematism which defines it as a principle of permanence, the category of substance is the source of any principle of conservation of physical magnitudes, namely of physical principles of invariance (conservation of energy, momentum, etc.). Besides, causality is expressed by forces.
(iv) Phenomenology. Galileo’s principle of relativity stems from the fact that absolute motion cannot be an object of experience. In kinematics, this means that the state of motion cannot be a real predicate, but only a possible predicate. It cannot be interpreted as a real transformation of the real internal state of the system, and of some of its properties taken as intrinsic mechanical properties. Hence, one can both assert and negate motion without any contradiction. In other terms, the relativity of motion invalidates the spontaneous ontological interpretation of statements such as “the body S has such and such position and velocity” in terms of a verb “to have” which would mean “to possess (a property)”. Neither a spatial or temporal absolute position, nor the absolute velocity (of a uniform motion in straight line) are observable. Dynamics however affords criteria of reality of motion, since forces are real predicates. This reality is ruled by laws of mechanics which are necessary. Here, necessity is not to be understood from the standpoint of logic, but from a transcendental standpoint: it is a conditional necessity, relative to the radical contingency of experience.
zh:
（iii）力学。实体范畴经由把它定义为持存性原则的时间图型化，成为物理量的一切守恒原理、即物理不变性原理（能量守恒、动量守恒等）的来源。此外，因果性由力来表达。
（iv）现象学。伽利略相对性原理源于如下事实：绝对运动不可能成为经验的对象。在运动学中，这意味着运动状态不可能是一个实在谓词，而只能是一个可能谓词。它不能被解释为系统的真实内部状态及其某些被视为内在力学性质的属性发生了实际变化。因此，人们可以既肯定又否定运动而不产生任何矛盾。换句话说，运动的相对性使诸如“物体S具有如此这般的位置和速度”这类陈述的自发本体论解释失效——那种解释把动词“具有”理解为“占有（某种属性）”。无论空间或时间上的绝对位置，还是（匀速直线运动的）绝对速度，都不是可观察的。然而动力学提供了运动实在性的判据，因为力是实在谓词。这种实在性受必然的力学定律支配。这里的必然性不应从逻辑立场理解，而应从先验立场理解：它是一种有条件的必然性，相对于经验的根本偶然性而言。

en: Another important feature of Kant’s approach is the “construction” of categories, when they are applied to a regional object such as motion. It is well-known that, in the Critique of Pure Reason, there is a difference between the so-called “mathematical” and “dynamical” categories. Unlike “mathematical” categories (which, by schematization, give rise to the “axioms of intuition” and to the “anticipations of perception” in the Analytic of Principles), “dynamical” categories (such as the categories of relation which, by schematization, give rise to the “analogies of experience”) posit existence and condition it, while leaving it undetermined. This means that they are not constructible. Since they only apply to the object in the most general sense, they are “mere forms of thought”, and are therefore only schematizable. But they become “constructible” – and thereby acquire “objective reality”, “meaning”, and “truth” – when they are applied to an “an additional determination”, such as motion, which “contains a pure intuition”. This is a crucial point to understand the relation between the Critique of Pure Reason and the MFNS, between a transcendental theory of knowledge and a transcendental approach of physics.
zh: 康德进路的另一个重要特征，是范畴在被应用于诸如运动这样的区域性对象时的“构造”。众所周知，在《纯粹理性批判》中，所谓“数学的”范畴与“力学性的”范畴之间存在差别。与“数学的”范畴不同（后者经过图型化，在原理分析论中产生“直观的公理”和“知觉的预测”），“力学性的”范畴（例如关系范畴，经由图型化产生“经验的类比”）设定实存并为之规定条件，却并不具体规定这种实存。这意味着它们是不可构造的。由于它们只适用于最一般意义上的对象，它们是“纯然的思想形式”，因而只能被图型化。但当它们被应用于“一个附加的规定”——例如“包含一个纯直观”的运动——时，它们就变成“可构造的”，并由此获得“客观实在性”“意义”和“真”。这是理解《纯粹理性批判》与 MFNS 之间、先验知识理论与物理学的先验进路之间关系的一个关键点。

en: To sum it up, Kant was the first thinker who developed the heart of modern physics constituted by the correlation between: relativity, symmetry, covariance, invariance, and conservation as a philosophical theme. It is precisely this correlation that has been generalized, diversified and deepened in fundamental modern physics (see Section 4 of this Introduction). It is therefore astonishing to see that a philosophy such as transcendental philosophy, which is so relevant to the essence of mathematical physics, has been rejected instead of being steadily improved along with the advances of science.
zh: 总而言之，康德是第一位把相对性、对称性、协变性、不变性与守恒之间的关联——现代物理学的这一核心——发展为哲学主题的思想家。正是这一关联，在基础性现代物理学中被推广、多样化和深化了（见本导论第4节）。因此，看到先验哲学这样一种与数学物理学本质如此相关的哲学，竟遭到拒斥而不是随科学进展稳步改进，实在令人惊讶。

en: 2 Various Interpretations of Kant’s Project for Constituting Objectivity: A Short Historical Outline
zh: 2 对康德构成客观性方案的种种解释：一个简短的历史概述

en: We will now briefly focus our attention on the history of Transcendentalism after Kant. This will help us to realize that appropriate generalizations of Transcendentalism were hindered by a combination of over-speculative interpretations and rigidly Kantian interpretations. This unfortunately led to the adoption of other epistemological traditions which were not as well adapted to the essence of mathematical physics as transcendentalism. But, at the same time, this history shows that another path could have been followed. The carefully scientific and flexible version of Transcendentalism advocated by the various neo-Kantian schools of the turn of the nineteenth and twentieth century was a good starting point for this alternative way.
zh: 我们现在把注意力简要转向康德之后先验论的历史。这将帮助我们认识到：对先验论的适当推广，曾被过度思辨的解释与僵化的康德式解释的结合所阻碍。不幸的是，这导致人们采纳了其他一些认识论传统，它们并不像先验论那样适应数学物理学的本质。但与此同时，这段历史也表明，本来可以走另一条道路。19、20世纪之交各新康德主义学派所倡导的先验论兼顾科学的严谨与方法的灵活，正是这条替代道路的良好起点。

en: But let’s first come back to our basic question. We have just seen that, as many authors from Hermann Cohen to Michael Friedman pointed out, it was his remarkable vision of the scientific theories of his time that enabled Kant to form the project of transcendental philosophy. If contemporary science rejects these theories, is transcendental philosophy bound to collapse as well? One common idea is that the historical limits of Kant’s philosophy of science indicate the limits of critical philosophy altogether. The consensus until now has basically been that Kant might have been right in claiming that rules exist ahead of experience, but he was faulty inasmuch as he seems to have believed that some rules are definitive as they reflect immutable structures of human reason. A short (and therefore incomplete) outline of the historical development that led to the sciences being disentangled from a Kantian foundation will now help us understand why and how some kind of rapprochement between the sciences and Kant’s general project can be obtained.
zh: 但让我们先回到基本问题。我们刚才看到，正如从赫尔曼·柯亨到迈克尔·弗里德曼的许多作者所指出的，正是康德对其时代科学理论的卓越洞察，使他得以形成先验哲学的方案。如果当代科学拒斥了这些理论，先验哲学是否也注定随之崩塌？一种常见的想法是：康德科学哲学的历史界限标志着整个批判哲学的界限。迄今的共识基本上是：康德声称规则先于经验而存在，这也许是对的；但他错在似乎相信某些规则是定论性的，因为它们反映了人类理性的不变结构。下面对科学如何摆脱康德式基础这一历史发展的简短（因而不完整的）概述，将帮助我们理解为什么以及如何能够在科学与康德的一般方案之间重新建立某种联系。

en: Let us first highlight some of the limitations of Kant’s system. Natural science and the theory of knowledge are closely interrelated in Kant. Whereas modern science has progressively disconnected the perceptual object from the scientific object, the whole of Kant’s original version of critical philosophy seems to be bound to some fixed balance between perception and cognition. Kant then brought together: (i) a statically conceived metaphysics of nature and (ii) an advance in empirical knowledge of nature, which is in principle endless. As a result, Kant could not give us the means to fully apprehend knowledge in its historical development. He perfectly accepted the idea of a historical evolution of the empirical content of science, but not an alteration of principles. Accordingly, many features of science are missing in his system. He did not make room for leibnizian principles of least action from which Lagrangian formalisms are derived. In his mechanics, Kant also lacks the concept of Work, which is why his epistemology cannot be applied to thermodynamics. Besides, Kant’s laws of nature are related to dynamics, and it would appear that they have no bearing on statistical laws. As a result, the allegedly immutable system of categories turns out to be both narrow and false.
zh: 让我们先突出康德体系的某些局限。在康德那里，自然科学与知识理论紧密交织。现代科学已逐步把知觉对象与科学对象脱钩，而康德原初版本的批判哲学整体上似乎被绑定于知觉与认知之间的某种固定平衡。康德于是把两样东西合并在一起：（i）一种静态构想的自然形而上学，与（ii）原则上无止境的自然经验知识的进展。结果，康德无法提供充分把握知识历史发展过程的手段。他完全接受科学经验内容历史演化的观念，却不接受原理的变更。相应地，科学的许多特征在他的体系中缺席。他没有为莱布尼茨式的最小作用量原理留出位置，而拉格朗日形式体系正是由这些原理导出的。在他的力学中，康德还缺少功的概念，这就是为什么他的认识论无法应用于热力学。此外，康德的自然定律与动力学相关，看上去它们对统计定律并不适用。结果，那个据称不变的范畴体系被证明既狭隘又错误。

en: This is precisely the challenge Kant faces today: How can we preserve the ideal of unity of knowledge, without ignoring the widening gap between common and scientific experience? Is there a way of vindicating Kant’s theories despite the fact that in the present state of physics the a priori (normative component of knowledge) is virtually impossible to separate from the empirical?
zh: 这正是康德今天面临的挑战：我们如何能够在不忽视日常经验与科学经验之间不断扩大的鸿沟的情况下，保存知识统一的理想？尽管在物理学现状中，先天（知识的规范性成分）实际上几乎不可能与经验成分分离，是否仍有一种为康德理论辩护的途径？

en: But this task took time to even be defined as such. The initial phase in Kant’s reception was operated by the idealistic movement. Fichte was the first author to emphasize the need for the primacy of practical reason over theoretical reason in his philosophy, and to assert that this reversal made the completion of Kant’s system possible. This strategy culminated in German Idealism, particularly through Hegel who argued for a totalizing view of knowledge which includes comprehensive concepts of natural and historical processes. But Kant’s views were also supported and reinterpreted by the pioneers of Naturphilosophie in Germany. Since mechanistic materialism was commonly taken as a necessary consequence of classical mechanics and mathematical physics in general, there was a search for alternative sorts of natural science which would in turn offer a vindication of the anti-materialist concepts of natural philosophy. Kant’s Critique of Pure Reason was thus interpreted as opening up the possibility of divorcing classical mechanics from materialistic dogmatism for the first time. As for the Critique of Judgment, with its reflection about aesthetics and about teleology in biology, it provided resources for an anti-mechanistic conception of nature influenced not only by physics but also by biology. From Kant’s description of the formal a priori background of knowledge there arose, as a result of the objective turn which Schelling gives to the Fichtean notion of intellectual intuition, a new metaphysics of nature. The subjective formal a priori was converted into a formative power at work in nature. The power of understanding was replaced with a creative force shaping organic development.
zh: 但人们花了很长时间，才把上述问题明确为一项任务。康德接受史的最初阶段由观念论运动主导。费希特是第一位强调其哲学中实践理性须优先于理论理性、并断言这一颠倒使康德体系的完成成为可能的作者。这一策略在德国观念论中达到顶峰，尤其通过黑格尔——他主张一种总体化的知识观，包含自然过程与历史过程的包罗性概念。但康德的观点也得到了德国自然哲学（Naturphilosophie）先驱们的支持与重新解释。由于机械论唯物主义通常被视为经典力学乃至一般数学物理学的必然后果，人们便寻找另类的自然科学，以反过来为自然哲学的反唯物主义概念提供辩护。康德的《纯粹理性批判》于是被解释为首次开启了把经典力学与唯物主义独断论分离开来的可能性。至于《判断力批判》，凭借其对美学和生物学中目的论的反思，它为一种不仅受物理学、也受生物学影响的反机械论自然观提供了资源。由于谢林赋予费希特的理智直观概念以客观转向，从康德对知识的形式先天背景的描述中产生出一种新的自然形而上学。主观的形式先天被转化为一种在自然中起作用的构形力量。知性的能力被一种塑造有机体发育的创造性力量所取代。

en: After the demise of this metaphysical natural philosophy (which took place around 1830), when this speculation could no longer be taken seriously from the scientific point of view, the fundamental tendency in science can be described as one of partial unification of theories and methods combined with a simultaneous explosion of experimental knowledge. To be sure, the mere idea of a completely unified natural science was unimaginable at the time. But the adventure of metaphysical natural philosophy left its traces: mechanism, as a total explanation of nature, became either a mere program or a philosophical dogma. The theories of heat, optics, magnetism, and electricity were largely independent divisions of physics, with a remote perspective of a unified mechanical interpretation and a more immediate urge for partial unification under appropriate principles. Most of the important innovations then arose as the result of a project of integration of these separate branches of physics; a project in which one can still feel the influence of Kant’s philosophical impulse. For instance, the integration of magnetic and electrical phenomena by Oersted was motivated by the application of Kant’s metaphysical claim concerning the duality and interaction of two fundamental forces (attraction and repulsion) to physics. This led to the theory of electromagnetism, which Faraday connected to mechanics, and Maxwell and Hertz to optics. The project of innovative integration transcended the limits of physics itself, also affecting chemistry and other disciplines; something that Kant had anticipated in his later Opus Postumum.
zh: 在这种形而上学的自然哲学消亡之后（大约发生在1830年前后），当这种思辨从科学观点看已无法被认真对待时，科学中的基本趋势可以描述为理论与方法的局部统一，与实验知识的爆炸式增长同时发生。诚然，一门完全统一的自然科学这一想法本身在当时是不可想象的。但形而上学自然哲学的冒险留下了痕迹：机械论作为对自然的总体解释，要么变成一个单纯的纲领，要么变成一条哲学教条。热、光、磁、电的理论在很大程度上是物理学彼此独立的分支，统一的力学解释只是遥远的前景，更迫切的诉求则是在适当原理下实现局部统一。当时大多数重要创新，正是整合物理学这些分立分支的计划的产物；在这一计划中，人们仍能感受到康德哲学冲力的影响。例如，奥斯特对磁现象与电现象的整合，其动机就是把康德关于两种基本力（吸引与排斥）的二元性与相互作用的形而上学主张应用于物理学。这导致了电磁理论——法拉第把它与力学联系起来，麦克斯韦和赫兹把它与光学联系起来。这种创新整合的计划超出了物理学本身的界限，也影响到化学和其他学科；这正是康德在其晚期《遗著》（Opus Postumum）中已经预见到的。

en: After Hegel, Schopenhauer rediscovered Kant’s need for distinction between phenomena and things in themselves. Accordingly, the vindication of Kant in the second half of the nineteenth century concerned his epistemological contribution as expressed in the Critique of Pure Reason, rather than his Metaphysical Principles of Natural Science. However, even Kant’s epistemology was subjected to intense scrutiny. After all, the key notion for post-idealist, anti-metaphysical philosophy in the nineteenth century was inductivism. From an inductivist standpoint, the Kantian a priori, along with all concepts, laws and theories, was conceived as nothing more than the result of empirical generalization. Thus, according to Helmholtz, the point at which natural science and metaphysics come into contact with each other is the theory of human sense-perception. Helmholtz therefore presented the results of enquiry into the physiology of perception in such a way that they fitted perfectly with transcendental philosophy. Science could now be seen as an open system of knowledge: a totality which is constantly growing and changing as a result of experience, so that science as a system of true judgments about the world is projected in the future; instead of delivering truth via fixed categories and intuitions, science is understood as a gradual approximation of truth. This is perfectly expressed in the view that came to be called a descriptivist or phenomenological view of natural science. The exclusion of metaphysics compelled physics to confine itself strictly to what is given, and what is given are phenomena. Concepts of substance or force were accordingly eliminated from science (Wundt, Hertz).
zh: 黑格尔之后，叔本华重新发现了康德区分现象与物自身的必要性。相应地，19世纪下半叶对康德的辩护，关注的是他在《纯粹理性批判》中表达的认识论贡献，而不是他的《自然科学的形而上学初始根据》。然而，即便是康德的认识论也受到严密审视。毕竟，19世纪后观念论、反形而上学哲学的关键概念是归纳主义。从归纳主义立场看，康德的先天，连同一切概念、定律和理论，都被设想为不过是经验概括的结果。于是，按照亥姆霍兹的看法，自然科学与形而上学彼此接触的交汇点是人类感官知觉的理论。亥姆霍兹因此以与先验哲学完美契合的方式呈现了知觉生理学研究的成果。科学现在可以被看作一个开放的知识系统：一个因经验而不断生长和变化的总体，因而，科学作为一个由关于世界的真判断构成的体系，只能在未来实现。科学并非通过固定的范畴和直观直接给出真理，而是逐步逼近真理。这在后来被称为对自然科学的描述主义或现象主义观点中得到了完美表达。对形而上学的排除迫使物理学严格局限于被给予的东西，而被给予的东西就是现象。实体或力的概念相应地被逐出科学（冯特、赫兹）。

en: According to this view (in good agreement with the spirit of Kant’s epistemology), the only concepts which should be used are those which make it possible to express functional connections between phenomena, so that the search for an underlying ontology is abandoned in favor of increasingly abstract mathematical representations of observables. Boltzmann, who supported this view to a certain extent, was convinced that the laws of thought arose by internal ideas’ being applied to actually existing objects, so that the existing laws of thought are inherited habits in a Darwinian sense. Current evolutionary epistemology considerably developed this approach. In it, the transcendental basis of knowledge is entirely re-interpreted in terms of the biological preconditions of experience. And the a priori is construed as the byproduct of an experience of the human species that became innate in the individual. This is a short step to abandoning the Kantian a priori as precondition of experience, since considering the a priori as an “organ” (something that resulted from phylogenetic adaptation to the experienced external world) destroys the very concept of the a priori in Kant’s original sense, namely as a precondition of experience. This is also not very easy to reconcile with several of Kant’s explicit statements (especially in his Response to Eberhard), according to which a priori does not mean “innate”.

However, those who defend a Darwinian and naturalized conception of transcendental philosophy can still rely on the fact that, even though Kant insists that a priori forms themselves are “originally acquired”, and therefore not innate, he also considers that the foundation of this cognitive process of original acquisition is itself innate.
zh: 按照这种观点（它与康德认识论的精神高度一致），唯一应当使用的概念是那些使我们能够表达现象之间函数联系的概念，于是对底层本体论的探求被放弃，取而代之的是对可观察量日益抽象的数学表示。玻尔兹曼在一定程度上支持这种观点，他确信思维定律产生于内部观念被应用于实际存在的对象，以致现存的思维定律是达尔文意义上的遗传习惯。当代进化认识论大大发展了这一进路。在其中，知识的先验基础完全被重新解释为经验的生物学前提条件。而先天被理解为人类物种经验的一种副产品，这种经验在个体身上变成了天赋的东西。由此到放弃作为经验前提条件的康德式先天，只有一步之遥，因为把先天视为一种“器官”（种系发生上对经验到的外部世界适应的结果），恰恰摧毁了康德原初意义上的先天概念，即作为经验前提条件的先天。这也很难与康德的若干明确陈述（尤其在《答埃伯哈特》中）相调和——按照这些陈述，先天并不意味着“天赋的”。
不过，为先验哲学的达尔文式、自然化构想辩护的人，仍可倚仗如下事实：尽管康德坚持先天形式本身是“源初获得的”、因而不是天赋的，他同时也认为这种源初获得的认知过程的基础本身是天赋的。

en: But it should now be borne in mind that there is more to Kant than his strictly critical system. For instance, the pre-critical Universal Natural History and Theory of the Heavens was the first coherent cosmogonical model compatible with suitably revised basic tenets of Newtonian mechanics. This theory can be seen today as pioneering the kind of evolutionary models in natural science, which became fashionable long before Darwin.
zh: 但现在应当记住，康德不止于其严格的批判体系。例如，前批判时期的《自然通史与天体理论》，是第一个与经过适当修订的牛顿力学基本信条相容的自洽的宇宙起源模型。这一理论今天可以被看作开创了自然科学中那类演化模型的先河——它们早在达尔文之前很久就已流行。

en: The physiological and Darwinian interpretation of Kant’s intuitions and categories was countered by neo-Kantianism, even though historicizing the a priori seemed from now on to be an inescapable route for any plausible revival of transcendental philosophy. At the turn of the twentieth century, Neo-Kantianism was the most important philosophical movement which developed in the intellectual climate of positivism. Its aim was to forge a new philosophy as an exact science, on the basis of the principles of Kant’s theory of knowledge. The central argument was that the essential aim of transcendental philosophy is to identify the fundamental methods and concepts of natural science. Hermann Cohen, who founded the Marburg School (later developed by Natorp and Cassirer), substituted a strictly logical conception of the Kantian program for the physiological interpretation inherited from Helmholtz. Here, intuition must be understood as a source of knowledge rather than as a psychological faculty implemented on a physiological substrate. Insofar as critical philosophy restricts philosophical reflection to the conditions of possibility of science, the fall into the psychological or physiological interpretation of the categories is completely avoided. After all, the function of the transcendental subject is to provide the necessary conditions without which “nature”, including the part of nature referred to by the physiological reading of Kant, means nothing at all. However, the Marburg School replaced Kant’s original “static” or timeless version of the synthetic a priori with what they perceived as an essentially developmental or “genetic” conception of scientific knowledge. The crucial point is that, in this case, development is represented by the ongoing history of science rather than the past history of our species.
zh: 对康德直观与范畴的生理学和达尔文式解释遭到了新康德主义的抵制，尽管从此，把先天历史化似乎成了任何可信的先验哲学复兴都无法回避的道路。20世纪之交，新康德主义是在实证主义思想气候中发展起来的最重要的哲学运动。其目标是在康德知识理论的原理基础上，锻造一门作为精确科学的新哲学。核心论点是：先验哲学的根本目标是辨认自然科学的基本方法与概念。创立马堡学派（后由纳托尔普和卡西尔发展）的赫尔曼·柯亨，用对康德纲领的严格逻辑构想取代了从亥姆霍兹继承来的生理学解释。在这里，直观必须被理解为知识的一个来源，而不是在生理基底上实现的一种心理官能。只要批判哲学把哲学反思限定于科学的可能性条件，就完全避免了落入对范畴的心理学或生理学解释。毕竟，先验主体的功能是提供那些必要条件，没有它们，“自然”——包括对康德的生理学解读所指涉的那部分自然——就毫无意义。然而，马堡学派用他们视为本质上发展性的或“发生的”科学知识构想，取代了康德原初的“静态的”或无时间性的综合先天版本。关键之处在于：在这种情况下，发展由科学的持续进行的历史来表征，而不是由我们物种的既往历史来表征。

en: The most famous representative of the Marburg school was Cassirer, who developed his early thesis about the relational-functional character of scientific laws in the context of classical physics, and his conception of the functional and historicized a priori in light of the then recent developments of the theory of Relativity (see Section 3 of this introduction). Cassirer argued that the genetic process of science is such that general laws at an earlier stage, are exhibited as approximate special cases of the still more general laws at a later stage, one obvious example being the road from Newton to Einstein. This being granted, many features of scientific theories that claim to be representations of things “out there” are reinterpreted as mere tools for this open task of generalization. For instance, non-Euclidean geometry as it intervenes in General Relativity does not express the nature of things themselves, but rather the laws and relations appropriate to a given stage of the systematic organization of science. One should not, says Cassirer, speculate about the being of space, but rather inquire into how scientists use geometrical structures.
zh: 马堡学派最著名的代表是卡西尔。他在经典物理学语境中发展了其早期关于科学定律的关系—函数性质的论题，又依据当时相对论的最新发展提出了函数化、历史化的先天构想（见本导论第3节）。卡西尔论证说，科学的发生过程是这样的：较早阶段的一般定律，被展示为较晚阶段更一般定律的近似特例——一个明显的例子就是从牛顿到爱因斯坦的道路。承认这一点之后，科学理论中许多自称是“外部”事物之表象的特征，就被重新解释为这项没有预设终点的推广工作的纯然工具。例如，在广义相对论中出场的非欧几何并不表达事物自身的本性，而是表达适合于科学的系统组织的某一给定阶段的定律与关系。卡西尔说，人们不应思辨空间的存在，而应探究科学家如何使用几何结构。

en: Cassirer also retained from Kant that the meaning of a concept is not tantamount to a mere abstraction out of the variety of its applications; the meaning of a concept must rather be identified ahead of application. Hence the idea, developed by some successors of Cassirer (e.g. G. Buchdahl), that Kant’s theories can be salvaged if the locus of the transcendental is not the constitutive dimension of the categories of understanding, but the regulative ideas of reason. In this case, the value of transcendental philosophy has shifted from the laws to the organization of these laws. This was a good way to go beyond Kant while grounding the move on Kantian premises, according to Cassirer’s famous slogan.
zh: 卡西尔还从康德那里保留了如下思想：一个概念的意义并不等同于从其各种应用中作单纯抽象；概念的意义毋宁必须在应用之前被确定。由此产生了卡西尔的某些后继者（例如 G. 布赫达尔）发展的想法：如果先验之所在不是知性范畴的构成性维度，而是理性的调节性理念，康德的理论就可以得到拯救。在这种情况下，先验哲学的价值就从定律转移到了这些定律的组织上。按照卡西尔那句著名口号，这是一条既超越康德、又把这一超越奠基于康德前提之上的好路径。

en: The theme of the flexibility of a priori forms, on which the neo-Kantian Marburg school insisted so strongly, was developed in many other ways outside this school. Perhaps the most extreme (yet a-historical) way of advocating flexibility while preserving the basics of Kant’s philosophy in light of contemporary mathematics and natural science, was advocated by Poincaré. Poincaré considered that: (i) the idea of a system of fixed categories as a foundation of natural science contradicts the history of natural science; (ii) a conventional (free) choice in the determinations of space and time have to supersede space and time as a priori forms of sensibility. In spite of this radical criticism of Kant’s foundationalism, Poincaré still perceived his own epistemology as Kantian. Indeed, he merely shifted Kant’s issue concerning the synthesis of the objects of knowledge to the problem of whether objective relations between objects can be described in terms of subjective capacities (including the visual, tactile and motor faculties that, according to him, underly our notion of space). He also thought that a generalization of Kant’s theory of space to spaces of constant curvature is possible provided one replaces Euclid’s axioms with a more general principle: the principle of free mobility allowing for the arbitrary continuous motion of rigid bodies.
zh: 新康德主义马堡学派如此强烈坚持的先天形式灵活性这一主题，在该学派之外也以许多其他方式得到发展。也许最极端（却是非历史的）的主张——在依据当代数学与自然科学保留康德哲学基本要素的同时倡导灵活性——是由彭加勒提出的。彭加勒认为：（i）以固定范畴体系作为自然科学基础的想法，与自然科学的历史相矛盾；（ii）对时空规定的约定性（自由）选择，必须取代作为感性先天形式的空间与时间。尽管对康德基础主义有这种激进批评，彭加勒仍把自己的认识论视为康德式的。的确，他只是把康德关于知识对象之综合的问题，转移到如下问题：对象之间的客观关系能否用主体能力来描述（包括在他看来构成我们空间概念之基础的视觉、触觉和运动官能）。他还认为，只要用一个更一般的原理——允许刚体任意连续运动的自由运动性原理——取代欧几里得公理，把康德的空间理论推广到常曲率空间就是可能的。

en: In another investigation of the structure and function of natural science, Kant’s transcendentalism was confronted with history even more brutally than in neoKantianism. According to E. Meyerson, stronger than the rational demand for lawfulness, is the demand for identity. The development of modern natural science, he says, reflects a perpetual dialectical opposition between: (i) the mind’s a priori demand for substantiality, and thus absolute identity through time, and (ii) nature’s irrational a posteriori resistance to such a demand. Interesting developments can be derived from this remark. Indeed, identity is more precisely instantiated by the concept of invariance, which is highly relevant for the symmetry groups that have played an increasingly prominent role in contemporary physics (e.g. the Lorentz group in special relativity). In agreement with his neo-Kantian conception of science, Cassirer argued that group theory does not represent “reality”, but is an instrument endowed with transcendental function, insofar as it provides the active link between the demands of the knowing subject and the definition of its object. By and large, invariance posits a new concept of objectivity disconnected from any ontological claim. Here, an object (or a class of objects) of a theory is specified as nothing else and nothing more than a bundle of invariant features.
zh: 在对自然科学结构与功能的另一项研究中，康德的先验论与历史的对撞比在新康德主义中更加猛烈。按照 E. 梅耶松的看法，比对规律性的理性要求更强的，是对同一性的要求。他说，现代自然科学的发展反映了一种永久的辩证对立：（i）心灵对实体性、因而对贯穿时间的绝对同一性的先天要求，与（ii）自然对这种要求的非理性的后天抵抗。从这一论断可以引出有趣的发展。的确，同一性可以借助不变性概念得到更精确的体现，而不变性与在当代物理学中扮演日益突出角色的对称群高度相关（例如狭义相对论中的洛伦兹群）。与其新康德主义科学观一致，卡西尔论证说，群论并不表象“实在”，而是一种被赋予先验功能的工具，因为它在认识主体的要求与其对象的定义之间提供了能动的联系。大体而言，不变性设定了一种与任何本体论主张脱钩的新客观性概念。在这里，一个理论的对象（或对象类）恰好被规定为一组不变特征。

en: 3 Constituting Objectivity in Relativity and Quantum Physics
zh: 3 在相对论与量子物理学中构成客观性

en: The accusation according to which Kant’s epistemology had become irrelevant to modern physics, was developed in intricate details as a reaction to the relativistic and quantum revolutions. Hence the need for a more detailed study of the role of these two theories in the debate about the possibility of a renewed transcendental approach.
zh: 关于康德认识论已与现代物理学无关的指控，是作为对相对论革命和量子革命的反应而被细致展开的。因此，需要更详细地研究这两个理论在关于一种更新的先验进路之可能性的争论中所起的作用。

en: To begin with, Relativity seemed to discard Kant’s Transcendental Aesthetic with its doctrine of space as an intuitive a priori form. Einstein stressed that, in view of the newly established status of non-euclidean geometry in the theory of gravitation, Kant’s thesis that a three-dimensional euclidean space is an a priori form of the human faculty of knowledge must be wrong. In Einstein’s own words, «Unlike one is ready to declare that relativity theory is averse to reason, one cannot stick any longer to Kant’s system of a priori concepts and norms».
zh: 首先，相对论似乎抛弃了康德的先验感性论及其把空间视为直观先天形式的学说。爱因斯坦强调，鉴于非欧几何在引力理论中新确立的地位，康德关于三维欧氏空间是人类认识能力的先天形式的论题必定是错的。用爱因斯坦自己的话说：“除非人们准备宣称相对论违背理性，否则就不能再坚持康德的先天概念与规范体系。”

en: Similarly, quantum mechanics seemed to discard Kant’s Transcendental Analytic, with its doctrine of substance and causality as categories, namely as conceptual a priori. Heisenberg was especially instrumental in denouncing both concepts as inapplicable to the quantum domain. He first claimed, in his uncertainty relations paper of 1927, that «quantum mechanics establishes the final failure of causality». Later, in 1929, Heisenberg became both more nuanced and more accurate. He no longer claimed that there was no room for causality in quantum physics. He rather pointed out that applying the law of causality and locating phenomena in space–time were complementary approaches, namely approaches that mutually exclude each other. But if causal laws cannot apply to spatio-temporal phenomena, Kant’s theory of knowledge is no longer valid, since his crucial category of causality has no other legitimate domain than appearances in space–time. In his book Physics and philosophy, of 1958, Heisenberg then explicitly stated that «Kant’s arguments for the a priori character of the law of causality no longer apply».
zh: 类似地，量子力学似乎抛弃了康德的先验分析论及其把实体与因果性作为范畴、即作为概念性先天的学说。海森堡在指斥这两个概念不适用于量子领域方面尤其起了作用。他先是在1927年的不确定性关系论文中宣称，“量子力学确立了因果性的最终失败”。后来在1929年，海森堡变得更细致也更准确。他不再宣称量子物理学中没有因果性的位置，而是指出：应用因果律与把现象定位于时空之中，是互补的进路，即彼此排斥的进路。但如果因果定律不能应用于时空现象，康德的知识理论就不再有效，因为他至关重要的因果性范畴除了时空中的显象之外没有别的合法适用领域。在其1958年的《物理学与哲学》一书中，海森堡于是明确断言：“康德为因果律的先天性所作的论证不再适用。”

en: Yet, at the same time as Kant’s conception of knowledge was thus challenged, several neo-kantian philosophers found many reasons in modern physics to not only stick to the basic ideas of transcendental epistemology as formulated by Kant, but to generalize and even to amplify them. The central motivation of this return to Kant was that both relativistic and quantum theories reactualized the basic move of the so-called «Copernican revolution». In both theories, one could no longer focus exclusively on a description of objects, but had to seriously consider the cognitive, or at least instrumental, pre-conditions of this description. In other terms, a reflective attitude, that is typical of transcendental epistemology, was required.
zh: 然而，就在康德的知识构想受到如此挑战的同时，几位新康德主义哲学家却在现代物理学中找到了许多理由，不仅坚持康德所表述的先验认识论的基本思想，而且推广乃至扩充它们。这种返回康德的核心动机在于：相对论和量子理论都重新激活了所谓“哥白尼式革命”的基本转向。在这两个理论中，人们不能再只专注于对象的描述，而必须认真考虑这种描述的认知前提条件，或至少是仪器方面的前提条件。换句话说，先验认识论所特有的反思态度成了必需。

en: In the theory of relativity, Ernst Cassirer thus noticed that one must: (i) investigate how measurements of length and duration are obtained and coordinated, and (ii) formulate a systematic method of extracting invariants from them.
zh: 于是，在相对论中，恩斯特·卡西尔注意到人们必须：（i）研究长度与时长的测量是如何获得并相互协调的，（ii）表述一种从中提取不变量的系统方法。

en: In quantum mechanics as understood by Bohr, the conclusion to be drawn was even more general. Here, considerations about contextuality, about how any microphenomenon whatsoever is both relative to and indissociable from an experimental context, are central. Grete Hermann, a German philosopher who had extensive discussions with Heisenberg in 1934, concluded that not only had Kant’s philosophy not been refuted by quantum mechanics, it had also been made more indispensible and pushed to its most radical consequence in the new physics.
zh: 在玻尔所理解的量子力学中，应得出的结论甚至更为一般。这里，关于语境性的考虑——任何微观现象都既相对于一个实验语境、又与之不可分离——处于中心地位。1934年曾与海森堡广泛讨论的德国哲学家格雷特·亨利-赫尔曼（Grete Hermann）得出结论：康德的哲学不仅没有被量子力学驳倒，反而在新物理学中更加不可或缺，其思想也被推演到最彻底的结论。

en: So, at this point, we must list and discuss some strategies for promoting the essential ideas of Kant’s theory of knowledge, without sticking to the historical features of the doctrine that were clearly made obsolete by relativistic and quantum theories. We believe that there are essentially three such strategies.
zh: 因此，在这一点上，我们必须列举并讨论一些策略，用以推进康德知识理论的核心思想，而不拘泥于该学说中显然已被相对论和量子理论淘汰的历史特征。我们认为，这样的策略本质上共有三种。

en:
1. The first strategy consists in restricting the validity of Kant’s original synthetic a priori to the direct environment of mankind, in which classical physics remain a good approximation.
2. The second strategy amounts to formulating new pre-conditions of knowledge that are general enough to encompass the extended domains of phenomena which are accounted for by modern physical theories and, hopefully, any future physical theory as well.
3. Finally, the third strategy consists in «relativizing» the a priori, namely making it relative to a certain situation of science that can change from one step to another of its history.
zh:
1. 第一种策略在于把康德原初综合先天的有效性限制在人类的直接环境中，在那里经典物理学仍是良好的近似。
2. 第二种策略在于表述新的知识前提条件，它们足够一般，足以涵盖现代物理理论所解释的扩展现象领域，并且有望涵盖任何未来的物理理论。
3. 最后，第三种策略在于把先天“相对化”，即让它相对于科学的某种状况，而这种状况可以随科学历史从一个阶段到另一个阶段而变化。

en: Restricting the domain of validity of Kant’s forms of intuition and categories is what Einstein, Bohr and Heisenberg did almost spontaneously after they had formulated their revolutionary theories. All these authors expressed the idea that Kant’s a priori forms remain unshakable anthropocentric foundations of physical knowledge.
zh: 限制康德直观形式与范畴的有效域，正是爱因斯坦、玻尔和海森堡在提出各自革命性理论之后几乎自发做的事情。这些作者都表达了这样的想法：康德的先天形式仍是物理知识不可动摇的人类中心基础。

en: Thus Einstein pointed out in 1921 that Riemannian geometry is grounded on the presupposition that there are rigid bodies which behave as if Euclidean geometry were locally valid. But he also warned against any reification of this local validity. As he wrote, “The concepts which proved useful in order to establish a certain order easily acquire for us such an authoritative status that we forget their earthly origin and that we come to construe them as immutable data”.

So, according to Einstein, Kant’s forms of intuition are nothing else and nothing more than local principles of order which act as minimal presuppositions for any further attempt at extending physics beyond the limited environment of mankind.
zh: 于是爱因斯坦在1921年指出，黎曼几何奠基于如下预设：存在这样的刚体，其行为仿佛欧氏几何在局部有效。但他也警告不要把这种局部有效性物化。正如他所写：“为建立某种秩序而被证明有用的概念，很容易在我们这里获得如此权威的地位，以致我们忘记它们的尘世起源，把它们理解为不可更改的所予。”
因此，按照爱因斯坦的看法，康德的直观形式不多不少只是局部的秩序原理，它们充当把物理学扩展到人类有限环境之外的任何进一步尝试的最小预设。

en: As for Bohr and Heisenberg, they promoted the same idea, but applied it to Kant’s categories, especially substance and causality, rather than to the forms of intuition. According to both of them, the classical organization of macroscopic experience is a precondition for any further theoretical development, including Quantum Mechanics. But Kant’s categories are clearly preconditions for this classical organization. These categories therefore work de facto as second-order anthropocentric presuppositions of quantum mechanics, even though they cannot work as general first-order presuppositions that are directly applied to microscopic phenomena. Heisenberg thus remarked that: “What Kant had not foreseen was that these a priori concepts can be the conditions for science and at the same time have a limited range of applicability”.
zh: 至于玻尔和海森堡，他们推进了同样的想法，但把它应用于康德的范畴——尤其是实体与因果性——而不是直观形式。按照他们两人的看法，宏观经验的经典组织是任何进一步理论发展（包括量子力学）的前提条件。而康德的范畴显然是这种经典组织的前提条件。因此，这些范畴事实上作为量子力学的二阶人类中心预设起作用，尽管它们不能作为直接应用于微观现象的一般一阶预设起作用。海森堡于是评论道：“康德没有预见到的是，这些先天概念既可以成为科学的条件，同时又只有有限的适用范围。”

en: Accepting that the constitutive role of the categories of the Critique of Pure Reason only applies to the meso-macroscopic domain looks like a partial renunciation of the Kantian project. Yet, one must not forget that Kant’s philosophy has enough resources to also formulate constructive propositions on what does not directly fall under the joint rule of forms of intuition and categories of pure understanding. Let us take an example. Kant claimed that certain figures of non-euclidean geometry are impossible insofar as the possibility of constructing them in intuitive space is concerned. But he also accepted that “(…) there is no contradiction in the concept of a figure enclosed by two straight lines”.

It can be inferred from this that Kant did not exclude using such concepts in order to fulfill the need of a systematic unity of the laws of physics according to what is prescribed by the power of judgment.
zh: 承认《纯粹理性批判》诸范畴的构成性作用只适用于介观—宏观领域，看上去像是对康德方案的部分放弃。然而，人们不应忘记：康德的哲学有足够的资源，对不直接落入直观形式与纯粹知性范畴共同支配之下的东西，也能提出建设性的命题。让我们举个例子。康德宣称，就在直观空间中构造非欧几何某些图形的可能性而言，这些图形是不可能的。但他也承认：“（……）由两条直线围成一个图形的概念中并没有矛盾。”
由此可以推知，康德并不排除按照判断力所规定的要求、为满足物理定律的系统统一性之需要而使用这类概念。

en: This resource has recently been used to make sense of Quantum Mechanics in a strictly Kantian framework.

The approach here consists in understanding quantum theoretical structures, not as direct expressions of the constitutive function of categories, typical of the Critique of Pure Reason, but as a formal transcription of a project of unity of the system of nature, typical of the Critique of Judgment. Let us see how this can be done. We know that any prospect of conceptual unity appeared to be blocked in the period of edification of quantum theories, between 1900 and 1924, when one had to accept that using mutually exclusive representations such as the corpuscule and wave pictures, cannot be avoided. Some sort of unity was restored only when Bohr formulated his concept of “complementarity”, according to which these two exclusive representations (i) are relative to different types of experimental devices and different types of correlative classical concepts, and (ii) jointly characterize “one and the same object”. However, it must be realized that the hypothetical object towards which the two complementary representations are supposed to converge cannot be said to simultaneously possess the two corresponding properties. No constituted object can therefore be said to be “behind” the contextual phenomena. Bohr’s “objects” are only regulative devices used as unifying symbols, with a merely “as if” causal role. In the same way as in Kant’s Critique of Judgment, one must here use a purely «symbolic analogy», instead of the normal constitutive «analogy of experience» which would only be available for proper objects of intuition.
zh: 近来有人利用这一资源，在严格康德式的框架内理解量子力学。

这里的进路在于：不把量子理论结构理解为范畴构成性功能的直接表达（那是《纯粹理性批判》的典型特征），而是理解为自然系统之统一性计划的形式转写（那是《判断力批判》的典型特征）。让我们看看这如何可能。我们知道，在1900至1924年量子理论的创建时期，任何概念统一的前景似乎都被堵死了，因为人们不得不承认：使用粒子图像与波动图像这类相互排斥的表象是不可避免的。只有当玻尔提出其“互补性”概念时，某种统一才得以恢复：按照这一概念，这两种互斥的表象（i）相对于不同类型的实验装置和不同类型的相关经典概念，并且（ii）共同刻画“同一个对象”。然而，必须认识到：两个互补表象被认为收敛于其上的那个假设性对象，不能被说成同时拥有两种相应的属性。因此，不能说有任何已构成的对象在语境性现象“背后”。玻尔的“对象”只是用作统一化符号的调节性手段，只有一种纯然“仿佛”的因果作用。正如在康德的《判断力批判》中那样，这里必须使用一种纯然的“象征类比”，而不是只对真正的直观对象才可用的那种通常的构成性“经验类比”。

en: But this attempt at finding resources in strict accordance with Kant’s texts, including the Critique of Judgment, is by no means the only way of maintaining and developing the relevance of transcendental epistemology in modern physics. Let us then turn to the second available strategy, which consists in generalizing the synthetic a priori. Here, the hope is to succeed where Kant failed, namely finding some really necessary preconditions for any empirical knowledge at any time of history. Along with this perspective, the project aims to show that the basic structures of physical laws essentially express the structures of these very broad presuppositions. Demonstrating that, is what one may call ‘giving a transcendental justification’ of a physical theory. But these two aims are likely to be conflicting. Indeed, a set of preconditions general enough to be universal and perennial is likely to be so poor in content that very little of the law-like structures can be justified by it. While a reasonably large part of the law-like structure of Classical Mechanics could be transcendentally justified by Kant’s preconditions, a much smaller part of any physical theory would be justified by truly general preconditions.
zh: 但这种严格依照康德文本（包括《判断力批判》）寻找资源的尝试，绝不是在现代物理学中维持并发展先验认识论之相关性的唯一途径。那么让我们转向第二种可用策略，即推广综合先天。这里的希望是在康德失败之处取得成功，即找到对历史上任何时期的任何经验知识都真正必要的前提条件。伴随这一视角，该计划旨在表明物理定律的基本结构本质上表达这些极其宽泛的预设的结构。证明这一点，就是人们所谓对一个物理理论“给出先验辩护”。但这两个目标很可能相互冲突。的确，一套一般到足以普遍且恒久的前提条件，其内容很可能贫乏到只能为体现定律的结构中很少的一部分提供辩护。虽然经典力学的定律结构中相当大的一部分可以由康德的前提条件先验地辩护，但任何物理理论中能被真正一般的前提条件辩护的部分要小得多。

en: This strategy was especially advocated by C. F. von Weizsäcker,

in his most recent work. He formulated two central preconditions for any scientific knowledge, far more general than Kant’s. The first precondition is that it must be possible to discriminate between at least two phenomena. The second precondition is that one must be able to distinguish between potential and actual phenomena, namely between future and past, between prediction and possession of information. Undoubtedly one can hardly conceive any item of scientific knowledge that does not rely on a possibility of discrimination and on the prospect of gaining information in the course of time. But, in view of these presuppositions’ being so elementary, it is not surprising that Von Weizsäcker’s project of deriving modern physics from them failed, except for some very broad features.
zh: C. F. 冯·魏茨泽克尤其在其晚近的著作中倡导了这一策略。
他为任何科学知识表述了两个核心前提条件，远比康德的更一般。第一个前提条件是：必须能够区分至少两个现象。第二个前提条件是：必须能够区分潜在现象与现实现象，即区分未来与过去、区分预测与信息占有。毫无疑问，几乎无法设想任何一项科学知识不依赖于区分的可能性、以及随时间获得信息的前景。但鉴于这些预设如此初级，冯·魏茨泽克试图从中推导出现代物理学的计划并未成功，所推出的只有一些极为概括的特征，也就不足为奇。

en: Let us then turn to the third strategy for giving transcendental epistemology new relevance in modern physics and recognizing its constitutive features: the strategy of relativized and historicized a priori.
zh: 那么让我们转向使先验认识论在现代物理学中重获相关性并确认其构成性特征的第三种策略：相对化、历史化先天的策略。

en: Here are first some arguments in favor of the relativized a priori. To begin with, it is clear that the relativized a priori is fully compatible with the two previous options. Bringing out specialized relative a priori structures does not prevent one from extracting more universal preconditions. Indeed, the most general and poorest preconditions of empirical knowledge (such as Von Weizsäcker’s) might easily be construed as invariants of the many special and richer preconditions for each region of experience. Furthermore, saying as Einstein, Bohr, and Heisenberg did, that the validity of Kant’s forms of intuition and thought is restricted to our mesoscopic environment, can also be taken to mean that Kant’s forms are relative to the range of rules and procedures taking place within this environment. They are preconditions for the most familiar region of experience. This being granted, Einstein’s, Bohr’s and Heisenberg’s restriction can be taken by contrast as an incentive to identify new anticipative forms which are relevant to the new range of phenomena and procedures explored by microphysics.
zh: 下面先给出一些支持相对化先天的论证。首先，很清楚，相对化先天与前两个选项完全相容。提炼专门化的相对先天结构，并不妨碍人们提取更普遍的前提条件。的确，经验知识最一般、最贫乏的前提条件（例如冯·魏茨泽克的），可以很容易被理解为针对每个经验区域的众多特殊而更丰富的前提条件的不变量。此外，像爱因斯坦、玻尔和海森堡那样说康德直观形式与思想形式的有效性限于我们的介观环境，也可以被理解为：康德所说的形式是相对于在这一环境中适用的规则和实施的程序而言的。它们是最熟悉经验区域的前提条件。承认这一点之后，爱因斯坦、玻尔和海森堡的限制反过来可以被看作一种激励：去辨认与微观物理学所探索的新现象范围和新程序相关的新的预期形式。

en: Another point in favor of the relativized a priori is that, as we will now see, it is not too difficult to confute the accusation according to which it is empty, arbitrary, and amounts to little more than a restatement of basic scientific methodologies.
zh: 支持相对化先天的另一点是：正如我们接下来将看到的，要驳倒那种说它空洞、任意、不过是基本科学方法论之重述的指控，并不太难。

en: This accusation was first formulated by Einstein against Cassirer’s reading of the theory of Relativity. According to Einstein, “One can always set up a system of a priori elements in such a way that it is not contradictory with a given physical system”.

If this trend towards relativization is pushed to its ultimate consequences, Einstein concludes, one lands into little more than the hypothetico-deductive method. The only component of Kantianism which still seems to be retained at this point is a recognition of the spontaneity of reason, namely the fact that our reason always tends to anticipate phenomena with a set of constructive hypotheses. Transcendental methodology would then be reduced to Peirce’s Abduction, or to Popper’s conjecture of regularities.
zh: 这一指控最初是爱因斯坦针对卡西尔对相对论的解读提出的。按照爱因斯坦的看法，“人们总是可以建立一个先天要素体系，使其与一个给定的物理系统不相矛盾”。
爱因斯坦断言，如果把这种相对化倾向推到其最终后果，人们得到的就不过是假说—演绎方法。在这一点上似乎仍被保留的唯一康德主义成分，是对理性自发性的承认，即我们的理性总是倾向于用一组构造性假说来预期现象这一事实。于是，先验方法论就会被还原为皮尔士的溯因，或波普尔对规律性的猜想。

en: So, if a transcendental epistemology is to retain any specificity at all, one must not push relativization to a point where it can no longer be distinguished from an ongoing dialectic of conjectures and tests. But is this possible? We think the answer is «yes»: this is indeed possible. There is a key difference between an a priori background and a mere conjecture. The difference bears on necessity. An a priori form is somehow necessary; not a conjecture. But of course, the concept of necessity must here be seriously qualified if we do not want to fall back into the absolute and eternal a priori forms of Kant.
zh: 因此，如果先验认识论要保留任何特异性，就不能把相对化推到它与猜想和检验的持续辩证过程再也无法区分的地步。但这可能吗？我们认为答案是“可能的”：这确实可能。先天背景与单纯猜想之间有一个关键差别。这个差别关乎必然性。先天形式在某种意义上是必然的；猜想则不是。但当然，如果我们不想退回康德那种绝对而永恒的先天形式，这里的必然性概念就必须受到严格限定。

en: Let us illustrate this idea of a qualified necessity with an example. Hans Reichenbach was probably the first author who formulated, in 1920, the idea of a relativized a priori in direct response to modern physics (in his Theory of relativity and a priori knowledge). But according to him one must carefully separate: (1) the constitutive components, and (2) the apodictic (or necessary) components, of the a priori in physics. Along with point (1), Reichenbach insists: (i) that one can isolate «coordinating principles» which are crucial to any physical theory

; and (ii) that these coordinating principles are constitutive of the objects of this theory, because they prescribe the framework against which some phenomena can be interpreted as fleeting appearances of permanent objects. But, says Reichenbach, they are by no means necessary, unlike Kant’s categories of pure understanding. The component of the a priori referred to in point (2) must then, according to him, be relinquished.
zh: 让我们用一个例子来说明这种受限定必然性的想法。汉斯·赖欣巴赫大概是第一位在1920年直接回应现代物理学而提出相对化先天想法的作者（在其《相对论与先天知识》中）。但按照他的看法，必须仔细区分物理学中先天的（1）构成性成分与（2）确然的（或必然的）成分。就第（1）点而言，赖欣巴赫坚持：（i）人们可以分离出对任何物理理论都至关重要的“协调原理”
；（ii）这些协调原理对该理论的对象具有构成性，因为它们规定了这样一个框架：在其中，某些现象才能被解释为持存对象的转瞬显象。但赖欣巴赫说，它们绝不像康德的纯粹知性范畴那样是必然的。于是按照他的看法，第（2）点所指的先天成分必须被放弃。

en: In this version of the relativized a priori, there is clearly more than in the hypothetico-deductive method, since the coordinating principles which are genuinely constitutive are carefully separated from the connecting principles which only state the relations between the properties of the constituted objects. By contrast, the usual conjecture-refutation method would merge both principles into a single category: that of corroborated conjectures or hypotheses. In spite of this difference, however, the idea that the coordinating principles lack any necessity was taken by Reichenbach, a few years after having written his Theory of relativity and a priori knowledge, as a good reason to abandon any reference to transcendental philosophy and to revert to empiricism.
zh: 在这个版本的相对化先天中，显然有比假说—演绎方法更多的东西，因为真正具有构成性的协调原理，与只陈述已构成对象诸属性之间关系的联结原理，被仔细区分开来。相比之下，通常的猜想—反驳方法会把两类原理合并为单一范畴：得到确证的猜想或假说。然而，尽管有这一差别，协调原理缺乏任何必然性这一想法，仍被赖欣巴赫——在写完《相对论与先天知识》几年之后——当作放弃一切对先验哲学的援引、退回经验论的好理由。

en: Let us now have a closer look at why Reichenbach decided to drop any claim of necessity in his view of the relativized a priori. His basic reason was of course that, if the a priori is to be historicized, one cannot retain any principle which would be “valid for all times”. Since Reichenbach identified “necessary” and “valid for all times”, it was obvious to him that the historically drifting constitutive principles are not and cannot be necessary. But we do not have to accept this identification of “necessary” and “valid for all times”. Less stringent definitions of necessity are available, and they can be used in the context of transcendental epistemology. One of them is conditional necessity: certain constitutive principles are necessary under the condition that a certain practice of research is implemented. But practices may evolve and a new network of presuppositions may then become conditionally necessary. Then, surprising as it may seem, a set of constitutive principles can be necessary and provisional at the same time!
zh: 现在让我们更仔细地看看，赖欣巴赫为什么决定在其相对化先天观中放弃任何必然性主张。他的基本理由当然是：如果先天要被历史化，就不能保留任何“对一切时代有效”的原理。由于赖欣巴赫把“必然的”与“对一切时代有效的”等同起来，对他来说显而易见：随历史变迁的构成性原理不是、也不可能是必然的。但我们不必接受“必然的”与“对一切时代有效的”这一等同。必然性有较宽松的定义可用，而且它们可以用在先验认识论的语境中。其中之一是有条件的必然性：某些构成性原理在某种研究实践被实施的条件下是必然的。但实践可以演化，于是一个新的预设网络可以变成有条件必然的。这样，尽管看上去令人惊讶，一组构成性原理可以同时既是必然的又是暂定的！

en: If we accept this, the procedure of transcendental justification can be activated again, though of course not in the same sense as Kant’s. Here, a transcendental justification would no longer be a regression from the fact of objective knowledge to certain concepts and principles which are taken to be “a priori conditions of the possibility of all experience”. It would only be a regression from a given historical project of intersubjective knowledge, to a set of preconditions which are necessary if this particular project is to be successfully carried out. A transcendental justification of certain general structures of a physical theory is thus possible in such a restrictive acceptation.
zh: 如果我们接受这一点，先验辩护的程序就可以重新启动，当然不是在与康德相同的意义上。这里，先验辩护不再是从客观知识这一事实回溯到某些被视为“一切经验之可能性的先天条件”的概念与原理。它只是从一个给定的主体间知识的历史计划，回溯到一组前提条件——如果这一特定计划要成功实施，这些前提条件就是必然的。于是，在这样一种受限的含义上，对一个物理理论的某些一般结构进行先验辩护是可能的。

en: In this sense, it now proves quite easy to justify transcendentally a large part of the structure of Quantum Mechanics. One can for instance derive a crucial part of the quantum formalism from assumptions about the limits of accessible experimental information
; or from assumptions about contextuality of phenomena, combined with a demand of unity of the mathematical tools used for predicting these phenomena.

This means a lot for the interpretation of quantum theories. This means that one is no longer compelled to understand quantum theories as a representation of the «external», «independent» world, with all the strangeness and paradoxes that are associated with such a representation. Rather, quantum theories can very naturally be understood as expressing the constraints and bounds of (experimental) knowledge. This is very much in the spirit of Kant, if not in the letter of his original texts.
zh: 在这个意义上，如今对量子力学结构的很大一部分进行先验辩护，已被证明相当容易。例如，人们可以从关于可获取实验信息之限度的假设
、或者从关于现象语境性的假设加上对用于预测这些现象的数学工具的统一性要求
，导出量子形式体系的一个关键部分。这对量子理论的解释意义重大。这意味着人们不再被迫把量子理论理解为对“外部”“独立”世界的表象，因而也不必接受随这种理解而来的种种怪异与悖论。毋宁说，量子理论可以非常自然地被理解为表达（实验）知识的约束与界限。这非常符合康德的精神，即便不符合其原文的字面。

en: Now, let us inquire further into how the procedure of constitution of objectivity can be applied to quantum physics.
zh: 现在，让我们进一步探究客观性的构成程序如何应用于量子物理学。

en: In everyday life and in using classical physics, considering that objects have been «constituted» may sound superfluous. After all, if such a constitution has taken place, it was in the ontogenic (or, possibly, phylogenic) past of human beings. The basic conditions of the constitution of objects have been permanently available since then, and they do not have to be questioned. Therefore, at present, everything looks as if the material bodies of everyday life and classical physics were given out there.
zh: 在日常生活和使用经典物理学时，认为对象是被“构成”的，听上去也许多余。毕竟，如果这样一种构成曾经发生，也只能追溯到人类个体发生的过去，或许甚至能追溯到种系发生的过去。从那以后，对象构成的基本条件一直恒常可用，无须再被质疑。因此，在当下，一切看上去都仿佛日常生活与经典物理学的物质物体是在外面被给予的。

en: But in microphysics, things are very different. The basic conditions of the constitution of objects in space–time are no longer available, and this forces us to think afresh about constituting new types of objects. To begin with, what exactly are these conditions of the constitution of objects in space–time? They essentially consist in clauses of active imposition of continuity and reversibility of the temporal sequences of phenomena. These clauses, when they are successfully implemented, give ground to the idea that there is something permanent or substantial retaining its own identity across space–time
: a “something” which is endowed with properties, and which can cause events. But none of these clauses can be enforced on the micro-scale
zh: 但在微观物理学中，情况非常不同。时空中对象构成的基本条件不再可用，这迫使我们重新思考如何构成新类型的对象。首先，时空中对象构成的这些条件究竟是什么？它们本质上在于一些规定，要求主动把连续性和可逆性赋予现象的时间序列。这些条款在被成功实施时，为如下想法提供了根据：有某种持存的或实体性的东西贯穿时空保持其自身的同一性
——一个被赋予属性、并且能够引起事件的“某物”。但这些条款没有一条能在微观尺度上被强制实施

en:
1. The scheme of identity requires the possibility of restoring the continuity of spatiotemporal trajectories in order to follow them; but, in view of Heisenberg’s uncertainty relations, no such trajectory is accessible to experience. At most, we can have access to a fuzzy trajectory. The continuity criterion, which defines identity, can then only be used with reasonable efficiency in situations of very low density.
2. The scheme of definition of properties requires reproducibility of phenomena across a large range of variation of perceptive or experimental history. But in quantum physics, when some pairs of measurements (those which bear on conjugate variables) are performed sequentially, the result of each type of measurement crucially depends on the order of the sequence.
zh:
1. 同一性图式要求能够恢复时空轨迹的连续性以便跟踪它们；但鉴于海森堡的不确定性关系，没有任何这样的轨迹可为经验所通达。我们至多能通达一条模糊轨迹。于是，定义同一性的连续性判据，只有在密度极低的情形中才能有效应用。
2. 属性定义图式要求现象在知觉史或实验史的很大变动范围内可复现。但在量子物理学中，当某些测量对（那些涉及共轭变量的测量）被相继执行时，每类测量的结果关键性地依赖于序列的次序。

en: 3. The scheme of definition of ordinary causality requires free substitution of well-defined antecedent conditions in order to check that a certain effect is determined (or at least probabilistically promoted) by a certain antecedent. But, in quantum physics, this definition cannot be applied to its usual mechanical domain, to wit motion. For, here again due to Heisenberg’s uncertainty relations, it is impossible to completely specify the spatial and kinematic antecedent conditions of a certain process of motion.
zh: 3. 通常因果性的定义图式要求能够自由替换定义明确的先行条件，以便检验某个结果是由某个先行条件决定的（或至少因该条件而更有可能发生）。但在量子物理学中，这一定义无法应用于其通常的力学领域，即运动。因为——这里同样是由于海森堡的不确定性关系——不可能完全指定某个运动过程的空间与运动学先行条件。

en: This means that all the schemes of reversibility which justify our belief in the existence of spatio-temporal objects called material bodies at our scale, are missing at the microscopic scale. What can we do at this point? Return to Kant’s method of constituting objectivity, but applying it differently and to a different pattern of phenomena.
zh: 这意味着，一切在我们尺度上为我们相信被称为物质物体的时空对象之存在提供辩护的可逆性图式，在微观尺度上都缺席了。此时我们能做什么？回到康德构成客观性的方法，但以不同的方式把它应用于不同样式的现象。

en: Let us first remember what motivated Kant’s conception according to which objects of perception as well as objects of science are constituted. Kant’s primary aim was to take a middle course between dogmatism and empiricism, between the view that objects are real entities independent of us and the opposite view that objects are merely imaginations of the human mind. A constituted object is neither isomorphic to a real object existing in itself, nor reducible to a figment of the imagination. So, what is it exactly? Let us read one of Kant’s clearest statements about this point. He wrote: “ (…) insofar as (…) presentations are connected and determinable (in space and time) according to the laws of the unity of experience, they are called objects ”.

Here, nothing other than presentations, namely appearances, is required. But these appearances are embedded within a structural framework provided in advance by our understanding: the laws of the unity of experience. This structural framework is what must be presupposed in order to organize the presentations into manifold complexes made independent with respect to any particular situation or to any particular subjective state. In other terms, the structural framework of our understanding provides us with cognitive invariants. This definition of (constituted) objects needs no reference to exteriority, except in the weaker sense of spatial exteriority; no reference to reality either, except in the weaker sense of empirical reality (a sense that has been revived in a modern version by Putnam under the name “internal realism”). Objects are by no means construed as part of external reality in the strongest sense; yet objects are as independent of particular subjects as one may wish.
zh: 让我们先回想一下，是什么促使康德提出知觉对象与科学对象都是被构成的这一构想。康德的首要目标是在独断论与经验论之间、在对象是独立于我们的实在实体这一观点与对象只是人类心灵想象这一相反观点之间，取一条中间道路。一个被构成的对象既不同构于自在存在的实在对象，也不可还原为想象的虚构。那么它究竟是什么？让我们读一读康德关于这一点最清楚的陈述之一。他写道：“（……）就（……）诸表象按照经验统一性的规律被联结并且（在空间和时间中）可规定而言，它们就被称为对象。”

这里，除了表象、即显象之外，不需要任何别的东西。但这些显象被嵌入我们的知性预先提供的一个结构框架之中：经验统一性的规律。这个结构框架正是为了把诸表象组织成不依赖于任何特定处境或任何特定主体状态的杂多复合体而必须预设的东西。换句话说，我们知性的结构框架为我们提供认知不变量。这种（被构成的）对象的定义不需要援引外部性，除非在空间外在性这一较弱意义上；也不需要援引实在性，除非在经验实在性这一较弱意义上（普特南以“内在实在论”之名在现代版本中复活了这一含义）。对象绝不被理解为最强意义上的外部实在的一部分；然而对象又如人们所希望的那样独立于特定主体。

en: A crucial point is that, here, objectivity no longer means complete detachment of entities and properties with respect to the cognitive apparatus, but coordination of phenomena into several strata of invariants across a variety of subjective and instrumental circumstances. The fact that the usual types of spatio-temporal invariants, namely material corpuscles, are no longer available in quantum physics should not prevent one from attempting some sort of coordination.
zh: 一个关键之处在于：这里，客观性不再意味着实体和属性相对于认知装置的完全脱离，而是把现象协调为跨越各种主体与仪器情境的若干层次的不变量。通常类型的时空不变量、即物质微粒，在量子物理学中不再可用，这一事实不应阻止人们尝试某种协调。

en: This quest of a radically renewed constitution of objectivity can be carried out in two steps. Firstly coming back to classical mechanics in this spirit and analyzing how objects were in fact defined in this theory, beyond the superficial claim that they are merely given to us. Secondly extending this mode of definition to microphysics, with some suitable alterations.
zh: 探索这种全新的客观性构成方式，可以分两步进行。第一步，以这种精神回到经典力学，分析对象在这一理论中事实上是如何被定义的，超越它们只是被给予我们这一表面说法。第二步，把这种定义方式扩展到微观物理学，并作出某些适当的改动。

en: When we perform an analysis of the status of objects in classical mechanics, we find that they are nothing else than the boolean lattice of those experimental propositions that are embedded in a covariance diagram corresponding to Galileo’s group. They ultimately play no other role in the theory than an invariant of Galileo’s group.

Any further statement according to which a classical object is a carrier of properties, beyond the level of these properties, is just a metaphysical addition, without any bearing on the way classical mechanics operates.
zh: 当我们分析经典力学中对象的地位时，会发现它们不是别的，正是嵌入对应于伽利略群的协变性图式中的那些实验命题的布尔格。它们在理论中最终扮演的角色不是别的，正是伽利略群的一个不变量。
任何进一步的说法——说经典对象在这些属性之外还是属性的承载者——都只是形而上学的附加物，对经典力学的运作方式毫无影响。

en: How can we transpose this procedure to quantum physics? Peter Mittelstaedt made a very interesting suggestion

after Schrödinger. He first noticed that if something holds the role Kant ascribes to a «substance», this something can only be the state Ψ itself, because (i) state Ψ gathers in its preparation a complete set of commuting observables, (ii) state Ψ is permanent, in good agreement with Kant’s first analogy of experience. He then added that, by contrast, those putative entities that are conceived as carriers of the same spatial and kinematic properties as classical bodies, namely particles, “can only be considered as fictional objects”.

One reason for this is that, given a certain state Ψ, only commuting observables can be taken as jointly “objective”, in the sense of their being mutually accessible without alteration. In contrast, since the spatial and kinematic observables that are united by the concept of classical bodies do not commute, they are not jointly objective. This is a clear incentive to dispense with the old type of objects called material bodies altogether, and adopt a new type of object instead. We have no need for fictional objects which are only able to generate paradoxes.
zh: 我们如何把这一程序移植到量子物理学？彼得·米特尔施泰特继薛定谔之后提出了一个非常有趣的建议。
他首先注意到，如果有什么东西承担康德赋予“实体”的角色，这个东西只能是态Ψ本身，因为（i）态Ψ在其制备中汇集了一组完备的对易可观察量，（ii）态Ψ是持存的，与康德的第一经验类比高度一致。他接着补充说，相比之下，那些假定承载着与经典物体相同的空间和运动学属性的实体，也就是粒子，“只能被视为虚构对象”。
原因之一是：给定某个态Ψ，只有对易的可观察量才能被视为共同“客观的”，即可以对它们逐一测量而不相互扰动。相反，由于被经典物体概念统一起来的空间与运动学可观察量不对易，它们不是共同客观的。这显然促使人们干脆抛弃被称为物质物体的旧类型对象，转而采用一种新类型的对象。我们不需要只会产生悖论的虚构对象。

en: However, in spite of this, few people cross the line, and replace the traditional body-like domain of objectivity with a new domain of objectivity such as the Hilbert space. Why is this so? We think this is due to the dominant realist attitude in epistemology. Realist philosophers of science are not content with invariant structures: they want “elements of external reality”.
