Now, the problem with states Ψ is that, although they are indeed abstract invariants (by Dirac transformation) across the whole range of observables, they are quite poor candidates, taken in isolation, to the title of “elements of reality”. Indeed, they are little more than mathematical generators of probabilities. And since they are generators of probabilities, they connect only indirectly, by means of Born’s algorithm, with genuine experimental invariants such as values of spatial or kinematic observables, whereas good old material bodies are supposed to carry them directly.
zh: 然而，尽管如此，很少有人跨过这条线，用诸如希尔伯特空间这样的新客观性领域取代传统的物体式客观性领域。为什么会这样？我们认为这是由于认识论中占主导地位的实在论态度。实在论的科学哲学家不满足于不变结构：他们想要“外部实在的要素”。而态Ψ的问题在于：尽管它们确实是跨越整个可观察量范围的抽象不变量（在狄拉克变换下），孤立地看，它们却是“实在要素”这一头衔的相当差的候选者。的确，它们不过是概率的数学生成元。而正因为它们是概率的生成元，它们只借助玻恩算法间接地与真正的实验不变量（例如空间或运动学可观察量的值）相联系，而我们所熟悉的传统物质物体则被认为直接承载这些值。

en: But unlike realists, transcendental epistemologists do not care at all whether an invariant represents reality or not. What they require is only that these invariants be completely free of any paradoxical feature, as general as possible, and able to unify the largest conceivable domain of knowledge. If those conditions are fulfilled, they feel free to say that they have reached an optimal state of objectivity in the effective sense of maximal independence with respect to any subjective, spatial and instrumental situation. This is more than enough for them.
zh: 但与实在论者不同，先验认识论者根本不在乎一个不变量是否表象实在。他们要求的只是：这些不变量完全没有悖论性特征，尽可能一般，并且能够统一可设想的最大知识领域。如果这些条件得到满足，他们就可以坦然地说，他们已达到客观性的一种最优状态——即相对于任何主体、空间与仪器情境的最大独立性这一有效意义上的最优状态。这对他们来说已经绰绰有余。

en: 4 Constituting Objectivity in Contemporary Physics
zh: 4 在当代物理学中构成客观性

en: We will now see how these ideas about constitution of objectivity can be extended to the most recent advances of theoretical physics, from Quantum Field Theories to Quantum Gravity.
zh: 我们现在将看到，这些关于客观性构成的思想如何能够扩展到理论物理学的最新进展，从量子场论到量子引力。

en: As already mentioned in section 1 of this introduction, in the MFNS, the “mathematical” categories are specialized into “phoronomy” and “dynamics”, whereas the “dynamical” categories are specialized into “mechanics” and “phenomenology”. But the constructibility of the latter does not result in a true geometrization of physical contents. In other terms, in this reading of the original version of classical mechanics as formulated by Newton, constructibility does not result in an ascension of the “dynamical” into the “mathematical”, nor in what Hermann Weyl called the transformation of kinematical principles into dynamical principles.
zh: 如本导论第1节已经提到的，在 MFNS 中，“数学的”范畴被专门化为“运动学”与“动力学”，而“力学性的”范畴被专门化为“力学”与“现象学”。但后者的可构造性并不导致物理内容的真正几何化。换句话说，在对牛顿所表述的经典力学原初版本的这种解读中，可构造性既不导致“力学性的”向“数学的”上升，也不导致赫尔曼·魏尔所谓运动学原理向动力学原理的转化。

en: Now, it is clear that a large fraction of the subsequent advances of mathematical physics consisted in a “stronger” progressive construction of the dynamical categories by means of stepwise extensions of the field of applicability of mathematical categories, namely by means of stepwise extensions of relativity groups and other symmetries, and therefore of covariance constraints as well as of conservation principles. One can thus give a natural transcendental interpretation of the generalizations of classical mechanics that were developed throughout the nineteenth century.
zh: 而很清楚，此后数学物理学进展的很大一部分，在于通过逐步扩展数学范畴的适用领域——即逐步扩展相对性群及其他对称性、从而也扩展协变性约束和守恒原理——对力学性范畴进行“更强的”渐进构造。于是，人们可以对整个19世纪发展起来的经典力学推广给出一种自然的先验解释。

en: Lagrangian and Hamiltonian formalisms (underpinned by symplectic geometry) allow two types of advances.
zh: 拉格朗日与哈密顿形式体系（以辛几何为基础）允许两类进展。

en: Firstly, they make it possible to reformulate Kant’s spatio-temporal synthetic a priori (constitutively correlative of Galileo’s relativity group and of the principle of inertia which states that geodesics are Euclidean straight lines and that inertial motions are uniform motions along a straight line) by considering that the Euclidean metric of space is a “background structure” of Newtonian mechanics. In a variational Lagrangian formalism, one calls “background structure” a structure that appears in the Lagrangian, but which do not have to be varied in order to obtain the Euler-Lagrange equations.
zh: 第一，它们使重新表述康德的时空综合先天成为可能（这一综合先天在构成上与伽利略相对性群及惯性原理相关联，后者规定测地线是欧氏直线、惯性运动是沿直线的匀速运动），其途径是把空间的欧氏度规视为牛顿力学的一种“背景结构”。在拉格朗日变分形式体系中，人们把出现在拉格朗日量中、但为得到欧拉—拉格朗日方程而无须对其变分的结构称为“背景结构”。

en: Secondly, another advance allowed by symplectic formalisms is represented by Noether’s theorem which connects relativity principles (i.e. principles of inobservability of absolute kinematical magnitudes) and symmetries (invariance of the Lagrangian), with the laws of conservation of corresponding physical magnitudes (principles of observability of the latter magnitudes). This theorem is somehow the transcendental theorem, which vindicates Kant beyond what he could have hoped, and beyond what he could figure out. Indeed, it develops to an unsuspected extent Kant’s project in the Phenomenology and Mechanics of his MFNS (see Section 1): deriving a definition of observable magnitudes from principles of inobservability implied by Galilean relativity.
zh: 第二，辛形式体系允许的另一进展由诺特定理代表：它把相对性原理（即绝对运动学量不可观察的原理）和对称性（拉格朗日量的不变性），与相应物理量的守恒定律（这些量可观察的原理）联系起来。这个定理在某种意义上堪称典型的先验定理，它在超出康德所能希望、也超出他所能设想的程度上为康德辩护。的确，它把康德在 MFNS 的现象学与力学中的计划（见第1节）发展到意想不到的程度：从伽利略相对性所蕴含的不可观察性原理，导出可观察量的定义。

en: Thirdly, in General Relativity, the content of transcendental principles is changed, but far from being weakened, the architectonic of transcendental philosophy is actually reinforced by this change. The “axioms of intuition” (with the corresponding kinematics) and the “anticipations of perception” (with the corresponding dynamics) are transferred from the global and metric level, which was typical of newtonian mechanics, to the underlying local and differentiable level. The relativity group of the theory then becomes the group of space–time diffeomorphisms. Accordingly, the constraints of covariance become more important. This makes it possible to reduce forces, along with the category of causality, to a generalized principle of inertia. Here, the geometrical synthetic a priori is no longer located on a metric level, but rather on the differentiable level; it concerns, e.g. the cohomology of differential forms. This change can be expressed by saying that the metric is no longer a “background structure” (be it Euclidian or Minkowskian), but becomes a dynamical element of the theory. This new stage of the geometrization of physics can be interpreted from the standpoint of transcendental philosophy as a chiasm between a generalized “phoronomy” (relativity) which becomes dynamical, and a “mechanics” which becomes kinematical (inertial). An important consequence of this is that diffeomorphism invariance deprives location from any physical meaning.
zh: 第三，在广义相对论中，先验原理的内容改变了，但先验哲学的建筑术远未被削弱，反而实际上被这一改变所加强。“直观的公理”（及相应的运动学）与“知觉的预测”（及相应的动力学），从牛顿力学所特有的整体度规层面，转移到其底层的局部可微层面。于是理论的相对性群变成时空微分同胚群。相应地，协变性约束变得更重要。这使得把力连同因果性范畴一起还原为一种广义惯性原理成为可能。这里，几何的综合先天不再位于度规层面，而是位于可微层面；它关涉例如微分形式的上同调。这一改变可以这样表述：度规不再是“背景结构”（无论欧氏的还是闵可夫斯基的），而成为理论的一个动力学要素。物理学几何化的这一新阶段，可以从先验哲学立场解释为一种交错：广义化的、变成动力学性的“运动学”（相对性），与变成运动学性的（惯性的）“力学”之间的交错。其一个重要后果是：微分同胚不变性剥夺了位置的任何物理意义。

en: Fourthly, in quantum field theory (gauge theories) one introduces “internal” degrees of freedom, and this yields broadened symmetry principles which considerably enrich the geometrization of physics by geometrizing interactions. As Yuri Manin (1988) claimed: “From a philosophical point of view, one can speak of a new wave of geometrization of physical thought which for the first time is sweeping far beyond the boundaries of general relativity”.
zh: 第四，在量子场论（规范理论）中，人们引入“内部”自由度，这产生拓宽的对称性原理，通过把相互作用几何化而大大丰富了物理学的几何化。正如尤里·马宁（1988年）所宣称的：“从哲学观点看，可以说物理思想出现了新一波几何化浪潮，它第一次远远席卷到广义相对论的边界之外。”

en: Since the pioneering research of Chen Ning Yang and Robert Mills in the 1950s, two classes of fields were then distinguished in gauge theories:
zh: 自杨振宁与罗伯特·米尔斯20世纪50年代的开创性研究以来，规范理论中区分出两类场：

en: (i) Matter fermionic fields, which are interpreted as fiber bundles over space–time
zh: （i）物质费米子场，被解释为时空上的纤维丛

en:
(the coordinates of fibers are internal degrees of freedom, and the symmetry group of fibers express internal symmetries of particles).
(ii) Bosonic gauge fields, which represent interaction fields mediated by exchanged virtual particles (bosons). These are interpreted as connections over these fiber bundles.
zh:
（纤维的坐标是内部自由度，纤维的对称群表达粒子的内部对称性）。
（ii）玻色规范场，代表由交换虚粒子（玻色子）所中介的相互作用场。它们被解释为这些纤维丛上的联络。

en: The particles which mediate interactions are therefore the quanta of connection fields over matter fiber bundles. The Yang-Mills Lagrangian is the norm of the curvature of connections. It is an invariant of the gauge group, and space–time contribute to it as a gauge field by means of the scalar curvature of its connection. Covariant derivatives then offer the possibility of expressing interactions geometrically. In this situation, gauge theories were able to “construct” interactions by introducing a dependence of internal symmetries of systems (which are apparently non spatio-temporal global symmetries associated with particles quantum numbers) on space–time. If these internal symmetries are thus localized, and if the invariance of the theories is required, corrective terms must be introduced. It then appears that the latter precisely generate the interaction terms. This means that forces and interactions can generally be derived from local conservation principles.
zh: 因此，中介相互作用的粒子是物质纤维丛上联络场的量子。杨—米尔斯拉格朗日量是联络曲率的范数。它是规范群的一个不变量，而时空通过其联络的标量曲率作为一个规范场对它作出贡献。于是协变导数提供了在几何上表达相互作用的可能性。在这种情况下，规范理论通过引入系统内部对称性（它们表面上是与粒子量子数相联系的非时空的整体对称性）对时空的依赖，得以“构造”相互作用。如果这些内部对称性由此被局域化，并且要求理论保持不变性，就必须引入修正项。于是可以看出，这些修正项恰好生成相互作用项。这意味着力和相互作用一般可以从局域守恒原理导出。

en: After a very long evolution, physical formalisms are thus able to take into account a very difficult metaphysical debate in which Kant challenged the Leibnizians. This debate is developed in Kant’s Physical Monadology (1756), whose central thesis combines physical atomism and geometrical continuism. In this early book, Kant claims that a monad “fills” a determined, non-punctual, portion of space, and that this is not incompatible with its infinite divisibility, as the monad has “internal determinations”. Indeed, Kant writes in proposition VII that internal determinations are not in space precisely because they are internal; they are therefore not divided when spatial extension is divided. The minimal space occupied by a monad is a sphere of activity, and not an extension. One had to wait for the modern concept of a fiber bundle to see a rigorous geometrical expression of this metaphysical intuition.
zh: 经过非常漫长的演化，物理学形式体系于是能够顾及一场极其困难的形而上学论战——康德在其中挑战了莱布尼茨派。这场论战展开于康德的《物理单子论》（1756年），其中心论题把物理原子论与几何连续论结合起来。在这部早期著作中，康德宣称一个单子“充满”空间中一个确定的、非点状的部分，而这与该空间部分的无限可分性并不矛盾，因为单子具有“内部规定”。的确，康德在命题VII中写道，内部规定恰恰因为是内部的而不在空间之中；因此当空间广延被分割时，它们并不被分割。单子所占据的最小空间是作用的范围，而不是一个有广延的实体。人们不得不等到现代纤维丛概念的出现，才看到这一形而上学直觉的严格几何表达。

en: Fifthly, in General Relativity, the absence of any “background metric” is connected with the research of global invariants. In contrast, in Quantum Fields Theory, the metric remains a “background structure”. Imposing the unification of the two theories is the problem of Quantum Gravitation. It is striking to see that the deepest proposition in this domain, namely Noncommutative Geometry, can be given a natural transcendental interpretation (see J. Petitot in this volume).
zh: 第五，在广义相对论中，任何“背景度规”的缺席与对整体不变量的探求相联系。相反，在量子场论中，度规仍是一种“背景结构”。如何统一这两个理论，是量子引力要解决的问题。引人注目的是，这一领域中最深刻的方案——即非交换几何——可以被赋予一种自然的先验解释（见本书 J. 珀蒂托一章）。

en: In summary, it has been possible to gradually construct a true formal ontogenesis of observable physical reality, by means of variational formalisms, Noether’s theorems, Riemann’s geometry, connections on fiber bundles, Feynman’s path integrals, and Noncommutative Geometry. This mathematical construction converted Kant’s synthetic a priori into algorithms of computational synthesis allowing to generate ever-expanding explicit models of measurable or observable phenomena. Transcendental approaches of physics allow us to elucidate the philosophical significance of this remarkable historical achievement.
zh: 总而言之，借助变分形式体系、诺特定理、黎曼几何、纤维丛上的联络、费曼路径积分以及非交换几何，人们已能够逐步构造出可观察物理实在的一种真正的形式发生学。这一数学构造把康德的综合先天转化为计算综合的算法，使我们能够生成不断扩展的、可测量或可观察现象的显式模型。物理学的先验进路使我们得以阐明这一非凡历史成就的哲学意义。

en: 5 Presentation of the Book
zh: 5 本书内容介绍

en: This collective book covers the whole span of issues which have just been indicated. It relies on an improved understanding of Kant’s historical views of mathematics and physics in order to see how a transcendental reading of relativistic and quantum physics can be carried out. It focuses on what is allegedly the core of the transcendental method in epistemology, i.e. the procedure of constitution of objectivity. Furthermore, it investigates the renewed forms this method must take in order to make sense of the latest developments in theoretical physics, from quantum field theory to quantum gravitation.
zh: 这部集体著作覆盖了刚刚指出的全部问题域。它依靠对康德关于数学与物理学的历史观点的更深入理解，来考察对相对论物理学和量子物理学的先验解读如何可能。它聚焦于客观性的构成程序，这一程序被视为认识论中先验方法的核心。此外，它还研究这一方法为了理解理论物理学从量子场论到量子引力的最新发展而必须采取的更新形式。

en: Let us now give a short outline of the chapters of this book. The first part is concerned by the history of transcendental epistemology, from Kant to the successive waves of neo-Kantianism.
zh: 现在让我们简要概述本书各章。第一部分关注先验认识论的历史，从康德到新康德主义的历次浪潮。

en: As an indispensible initial step, M. Friedman and P. Kerszberg both examine Kant’s approach of Newtonian mechanics. M. Friedman studies the impact of the metaphysical and theological background of Newton’s thought on Kant’s conception of space and gravitational action at a distance. But he also shows in exquisite details how this pre-critical background was thoroughly transformed by transcendantal philosophy. From then on, the Newtonian God was construed as a regulative idea of reason, and the conception of God’s (space-like) omnipresence in the universe as a “sublime analogy” which only has a “practical meaning”. P. Kerszberg then describes Kant’s transcendental reinterpretation of Newtonian kinematics and dynamics, from the Metaphysical Foundations of Natural Science to the Opus Postumum. He points out that, between Newton and Kant, there is a decisive shift: Newton loosely assumes that a physicist is free to choose the most convenient set of assumptions, whereas Kant shows that there are some general principles from which physics necessarily starts.
zh: 作为不可或缺的起步，M. 弗里德曼与 P. 凯尔茨贝格都考察康德对牛顿力学的进路。弗里德曼研究牛顿思想的形而上学与神学背景对康德的空间观和引力超距作用观的影响。但他也以精妙的细节展示这一前批判背景如何被先验哲学彻底改造。从那以后，牛顿的上帝被理解为理性的一个调节性理念，而上帝在宇宙中（空间式的）遍在这一构想被理解为一种只具有“实践意义”的“崇高类比”。凯尔茨贝格随后描述从《自然科学的形而上学初始根据》到《遗著》，康德对牛顿运动学与动力学的先验重新解释。他指出，在牛顿与康德之间有一个决定性的转变：牛顿只宽泛地假定，物理学家可以自由选择最方便的一组假设，而康德表明存在一些物理学必然由之出发的一般原理。

en: In the second subsection of the historical inquiry, the central strategy for moving beyond Kant while remaining faithful to his core epistemological program is addressed. As we mentioned in Section 3 of the present introduction, this central strategy is relativization and historicization of the a priori. Relativization is studied in Cassirer and Carnap, while Schlick’s criticism is also documented.
zh: 在历史考察的第二小节中，讨论的是既超越康德又忠于其核心认识论纲领的中心策略。正如我们在本导论第3节提到的，这一中心策略就是先天的相对化与历史化。论述考察卡西尔和卡尔纳普如何理解相对化，同时介绍石里克的批评。

en: C. Schmitz-Rigal emphasizes Cassirer’s remarkable intellectual freedom in his adaptation of Kant’s most basic insight. Kant’s static of constitution of objectivity by way of a priori forms, is reinterpreted as a dynamic of constitution of meaning by way of a multiplicity of symbolic forms. Here, objects are relative to an objectivation-project that can develop and change in history. Interestingly, Cassirer’s neo-transcendental conception was stimulated rather than hindered by the onrise of relativity and quantum mechanics. Indeed, according to Cassirer, relativity and quantum mechanics represent a remarkable advance towards self-awareness of the procedure of objectivation by physics. At the same time, the very procedures disclosed by modern physics represent a welcome occasion for the philosopher to understand the detailed workings of objectivation, and therefore to “reveal the constitutive conditions of the means of constitution themselves”. A. Cei and S. French then focus on Cassirer’s philosophical analysis of quantum mechanics. Cassirer’s crucial move consists in a redefinition of the causality principle comprehensive enough to encompass statistical physics and quantum “indeterminacy”. But another dimension which is at least as important as the former one, is Cassirer’s structuralist redefinition of the concept of object as an ‘intersection of relations’. C. Bonnet and R. de Calan turn our attention from neo-Kantian thinkers to logical empiricists who were still thinking under the spell of Kant. They concentrate on Moritz Schlick’s philosophy of knowledge. Of course, as every logical empiricist, Schlick denies the existence of anything like Kant’s synthetic a priori judgments (judgments that do not derive from experience, yet are indispensible preconditions of experience). But he also radicalizes Kant’s philosophy by declaring that the true a priori reduces to pure logical form. And he holds that the role of the denied synthetic a priori is played by conventions and hypotheses. Finally, P. Parrini goes further in the examination of Kant’s influence on logical empiricism, by focusing on Carnap. Carnap accepted and amplified Schlick’s rejection of the synthetic a priori, and his adoption of logical form instead. But he simultaneously developed a personal conception of the relativized a priori, which was able to vindicate Kant’s basic intuition in the context of modern science. His distinction between ‘external questions’ and ‘internal questions’ (namely questions that are external or internal to a certain framework of presuppositions) was especially important in this respect. Indeed, Carnap assumed that the boundary between ‘internal’ and ‘external’ (and therefore the whole framework of presuppositions) can be shifted whenever the evolution of knowledge makes it expedient to do so.
zh: C. 施密茨—里加尔强调卡西尔在改造康德最基本洞见时所展现的非凡思想自由。康德以先天形式构成客观性的静态模式，被重新解释为以多种象征形式构成意义的动态过程。在这里，对象以一个能够在历史中发展变化的客观化计划为参照。有趣的是，卡西尔的新先验构想受到相对论和量子力学兴起的激发而非阻碍。的确，按照卡西尔的看法，相对论和量子力学代表了物理学客观化程序走向自我意识的显著进步。同时，现代物理学所揭示的这些程序本身，为哲学家理解客观化的具体运作、从而“揭示构成手段本身的构成性条件”提供了可喜的契机。A. 切伊与 S. 弗兰奇随后聚焦于卡西尔对量子力学的哲学分析。卡西尔的关键一步在于对因果性原理作出足够宽泛的重新定义，使其能够涵盖统计物理学和量子“非决定性”。但至少同样重要的另一个维度，是卡西尔对对象概念的结构主义重新定义：对象是“关系的交汇”。C. 博内与 R. 德卡朗把我们的注意力从新康德主义思想家转向仍在康德魔力之下思考的逻辑经验论者。他们集中于莫里茨·石里克的知识哲学。当然，像每个逻辑经验论者一样，石里克否认存在任何类似康德综合先天判断的东西（那种不来自经验、却是经验不可或缺前提条件的判断）。但他也把康德哲学激进化，宣称真正的先天可还原为纯粹逻辑形式。并且他主张，被否认的综合先天的角色由约定和假说来扮演。最后，P. 帕里尼通过聚焦卡尔纳普，进一步考察康德对逻辑经验论的影响。卡尔纳普接受并扩充了石里克对综合先天的拒斥及其以逻辑形式取而代之的做法。但他同时发展出一种个人的相对化先天构想，能够在现代科学语境中为康德的基本直觉辩护。他对“外部问题”与“内部问题”（即相对于某个预设框架而言外部或内部的问题）的区分在这方面尤为重要。的确，卡尔纳普假定：只要知识的演化使这样做成为适宜，“内部”与“外部”之间的边界（因而整个预设框架）就可以移动。

en: In the second part of the book, we shift our attention from history to current philosophy of physics. But before each particular theory is dealt with for its own sake, one must ask a series of precise questions about the methods to be used and the general issues to be addressed if transcendental epistemology is to be adapted to modern physics.
zh: 在本书第二部分，我们把注意力从历史转向当前的物理学哲学。但在为每个具体理论本身展开讨论之前，必须先就如下问题提出一系列精确的追问：如果要使先验认识论适应现代物理学，应当使用什么方法、应当处理哪些一般问题。

en: R. Harré examines the possibility that the standard corpuscularian ontology of the initial phase of classical physics is underpinned by a dispositional stratum. Dispositions come either in a classical form (especially fields), or in a quantum form which is even more radical. An analogy is developed between this two (or many-) strata structure of the domain of physics and Kant’s duality of phenomena and things in themselves. Can one consider that emergent instrumental “affordances” manifest in terms of categories, just as Kant’s phenomena do, whereas the “world as it is” is made of pure acategorical dispositions? G. Brittan then tackles the issue of causality and indeterminacy, which is crucial for any Transcendental account of quantum physics. According to him, the required outcome of any procedure of constitution of objectivity is being able to consider various appearances or descriptions as aspects of the same item. Therefore, the problem of objectivation is a problem of identification. This being granted, (quantum) indeterminacy can be taken into account provided one constitutes unsharp objects which can be identified across space–time. But another conflict, between the urge to identify and nonseparability, must be addressed. Are the requirements of objectivation really missing in the quantum domain? Another central question is then addressed by P. Mittelstaedt: which conditions have to be fulfilled by observable data in order to count as appearances of an object? He states these conditions in technical detail, and evaluates the ability of macroscopic and microscopic observable data to be ordered according to the norms of the knowledge of objects. His conclusion is that whereas macroscopic data (corresponding to the domain of classical physics) can be ordered according to the norms of the knowledge of individual objects, microscopic data (corresponding to the domain of quantum physics) can only be ordered according to the norms of the knowledge of classes of objects. Therefore, Mittelstaedt claims, in quantum physics, the constitution of objectivity is restricted to kinds. Now, lawlikeness is the crucial feature of objectivation, in the Kantian tradition. G. Boniolo thus examines critically the debate about the “laws of nature” in the empirical tradition and points out that Kantian ideas have strangely been neglected for decades. He first explains Kant’s own stratified view of lawlikeness, with a priori principles of understanding as a universal ground, particular empirical laws embedded in these principles, and regulative ideals of systematic unity of laws on top. He finally offers a Kantian solution of the problem of discrimination between nomological universals and accidental universals. P. Kauark-Leite then insists on a class of principles of understanding that is usually forgotten in the discussions about Transcendental epistemology: the anticipations of perceptions. This class of principles is crucial, however, because it aims at expressing the role infinitesimal calculus, and especially differential equations, play in physics. But there is a major difference between classical and quantum mechanics in this respect: in classical mechanics, infinitesimal calculus is used for both descriptive and predictive purposes (it is meant to describe the present states of systems and to predict their future states as a direct consequence of this description); but in quantum mechanics, infinitesimal calculus can only be used for the sake of probabilistic prediction. However, P. Kauark-Leite points out that if the Critique of Pure Reason is correctly understood, objectivity is not really defined by a set of invariant properties, but rather by an invariant anticipative structure. This being granted, Kant’s strategy of constitution of objectivity can easily be extended to quantum mechanics. Then, M. Stöltzner turns our attention to another neglected aspect of Transcendental epistemology, initiated by Kant in the Critique of Judgment. In philosophy, this aspect concerns teleology, and in physics it manifests itself by the use of a Principle of Least Action (PLA). Does the PLA reintroduces finality in physics in the ordinary metaphysical sense? In the spirit of Kant, M. Stöltzner argues against such a simple reading of the PLA, and rather points out that teleological constraints act as regulative principles imposed onto the formalism of physical theories. They are thereby indirectly constitutive of particular laws of nature, and should be studied together with other varieties of the historically relativized constitutive a priori. B. Falkenburg then provides us with a final classification of the major principles of Kant’s theory of nature. With this chart of principles in mind, she enquires into whether the ordinary belief in subatomic processes underpinning microscopic phenomena can still be maintained in modern physics. The applicability of each principle to quantum physics is examined in detail, and it turns out that the status of the belief in a subatomic reality is more nuanced than usually accepted by either realist or empiricist philosophers. An important point is that, here again, the subatomic world cannot be construed as some piece of an independent reality, but rather as a fraction of the empirical domain which is relative to a set of macroscopic experimental contexts.
zh: R. 哈雷考察如下可能性：经典物理学初始阶段的标准微粒论本体论，以某个倾向性层位为基础。倾向性要么以经典形式出现（尤其是场），要么以更激进的量子形式出现。他在物理学领域的这种两层（或多层）结构与康德的现象和物自身二元论之间展开类比。能否认为，涌现的仪器“可供性”像康德的现象那样以范畴的方式显现，而“如其所是的世界”由纯粹的无范畴倾向性构成？G. 布里坦随后处理因果性与非决定性问题，这对量子物理学的任何先验说明都至关重要。按照他的看法，任何客观性构成程序所要求的结果，是能够把各种显象或描述视为同一对象的不同方面。因此，客观化的难题在于判定同一性。承认这一点之后，只要构成能够跨时空被辨认的非锐利对象，（量子）非决定性就可以被纳入考虑。但另一个冲突——判定同一性的要求与不可分离性之间的冲突——也必须处理。客观化的要求在量子领域中真的缺失吗？P. 米特尔施泰特接着处理另一个中心问题：可观察数据必须满足什么条件，才能算作一个对象的显象？他以技术细节陈述这些条件，并评估宏观与微观可观察数据能否按照认识对象的规范加以组织。他的结论是：宏观数据（对应经典物理学领域）可以按照个体对象知识的规范来整理，而微观数据（对应量子物理学领域）只能按照对象类知识的规范来整理。因此米特尔施泰特宣称，在量子物理学中，客观性的构成限于种类。而在康德传统中，合规律性是客观化的关键特征。G. 博尼奥洛于是批判性地考察经验论传统中关于“自然定律”的争论，并指出康德式思想几十年来奇怪地被忽视了。他首先解释康德本人对合规律性的分层理解：知性的先天原理作为普遍根据，特殊经验定律嵌入这些原理之中，定律之系统统一性的调节性理想居于顶层。他最后为区分律则共相与偶然共相的问题提供一个康德式解答。P. 考阿克—莱特随后强调一类在先验认识论讨论中通常被遗忘的知性原理：知觉的预测。然而这类原理至关重要，因为它旨在表达无穷小演算、尤其是微分方程在物理学中所起的作用。但在这方面经典力学与量子力学有一个重大差别：在经典力学中，无穷小演算既用于描述也用于预测（它旨在描述系统的当前状态，并把未来状态作为这一描述的直接后果来预测）；而在量子力学中，无穷小演算只能用于概率性预测。然而考阿克—莱特指出，如果正确理解《纯粹理性批判》，客观性其实不是由一组不变属性定义的，而是由一个不变的预期结构定义的。承认这一点之后，康德构成客观性的策略就可以很容易地扩展到量子力学。接着，M. 施特尔茨纳把我们的注意力转向先验认识论另一个被忽视的方面——康德在《判断力批判》中开创的方面。在哲学中，这一方面关涉目的论；在物理学中，它表现为最小作用量原理（PLA）的使用。PLA是否把通常形而上学意义上的合目的性重新引入物理学？本着康德的精神，施特尔茨纳反对对PLA的这种简单解读，而是指出目的论约束作为加于物理理论形式体系之上的调节性原理起作用。它们由此间接地构成特殊的自然定律，应当与历史地相对化的构成性先天的其他变体一起研究。B. 法尔肯堡随后为我们提供康德自然理论主要原理的一份最终分类。带着这份原理图表，她探究对支撑微观现象的亚原子过程的通常信念在现代物理学中是否仍能维持。她详细考察每条原理对量子物理学的适用性，结果表明：对亚原子实在的信念，其地位比实在论或经验论哲学家通常承认的更为微妙。一个重要之处在于：在这里同样，亚原子世界不能被理解为独立实在的某个片段，而应被理解为经验领域的一部分，其界定依赖于一组宏观实验语境。

en: In the second subsection of this second part of the book, we shift from general issues to more focused studies of modern theories of physics, starting with special and general Relativity.
zh: 在本书第二部分的第二小节，我们从一般问题转向对现代物理理论更聚焦的研究，从狭义与广义相对论开始。

en: M. Friedman first exemplifies the idea of a relativized and historicized constitutive a priori by applying it to the theories of Relativity. To achieve this aim, he undertakes a historical analysis of the connection between geometry and kinematics by way of the principle of relativity of motion, from Kant to Einstein. He advocates the idea that, far from hindering the onrise of Relativity, Kant’s conception served as a matrix for further development of physics after Newton, including Einstein’s theory. Y. Balashov then turns to the problems of relativistic cosmology. Applying a Kantian frame of thought to cosmology may look paradoxical, in view of Kant’s sharp criticism of the concepts of totality, such as the concept of “the world as a whole”. However, it appears that cosmology (including Einstein’s relativistic cosmology of 1917) relies extensively on transcendental arguments, namely on an examination of the conditions of possibility for describing global properties of the universe. An inventory of these transcendental cosmological arguments is undertaken by Y. Balashov. Finally, T. Ryckman examines the program consisting of extending the ideas of General Relativity to a unitary field theory including electromagnetism. Here, Hermann Weyl is a major reference. It is therefore striking that, throughout his theoretical research, Weyl was guided by principles derived from transcendental philosophies from Kant to Husserl. These principles were instrumental in his formulation of gauge theories. One then realizes that transcendental epistemology is not only a good strategy for making retrospective sense of theories, but also an excellent prospective path towards major theoretical breakthroughs.
zh: M. 弗里德曼首先把相对化、历史化的构成性先天这一想法应用于相对论，作为例示。为达此目的，他从康德到爱因斯坦，经由运动相对性原理，对几何学与运动学之间的联系进行历史分析。他主张这样的想法：康德的构想远非阻碍相对论的兴起，而是充当了牛顿之后物理学进一步发展（包括爱因斯坦理论）的母体。Y. 巴拉绍夫随后转向相对论宇宙学的问题。鉴于康德对总体性概念（例如“作为整体的世界”概念）的尖锐批评，把康德式思想框架应用于宇宙学看上去也许悖谬。然而，宇宙学（包括爱因斯坦1917年的相对论宇宙学）看来广泛依赖先验论证，即依赖对描述宇宙整体性质之可能性条件的考察。巴拉绍夫梳理了这些先验宇宙学论证。最后，T. 赖克曼考察把广义相对论的思想扩展到包含电磁学的统一场论的计划。这里，赫尔曼·魏尔是一个主要参照。因此引人注目的是：魏尔在其整个理论研究中，都受到从康德到胡塞尔的先验哲学所导出的原理的引导。这些原理在他表述规范理论时起了关键作用。人们于是认识到，先验认识论不仅是回溯性地理解理论的好策略，也是通向重大理论突破的极佳前瞻路径。

en: The following sequence of chapters deals with the role played by transcendental epistemology in the genesis and history of quantum mechanics.
zh: 接下来的一组章节讨论先验认识论在量子力学的发生与历史中所起的作用。

en: S. Brock first describes Kant’s and Helmholtz’ influence on Bohr’s thought and theoretical program. This influence can be seen when Bohr considered that complementarity, as an organizing principle of objective knowledge, is a generalization of the ‘ideal of causality’. Indeed, according to Bohr, causality can be analyzed into two complementary aspects: ‘space–time coordination’ and ‘dynamic conservation laws’. In the second half of his paper, S. Brock develops another (partial) parallel between Cassirer’s and Bohr’s views about physics. The connection between Kant’s and Bohr’s philosophies of physics is also the central theme of H. Pringe’s chapter. A central idea here is that in order to understand this connection one should rely more on the Critique of Judgment than on the Critique of Pure Reason. For instance, Bohr’s principle of correspondence can easily be seen as a maxim for reflective judgment when empirical analogies (between the classical and quantum domains) are looked for. As for complementarity, it plays the role of a ‘symbolic analogy’, namely a way to afford a twofold symbolization of objects (as waves and as corpuscles) in situations where complete unification of phenomena under a single picture of objects is not possible. L. Soler then studies one of the most accomplished and heroic attempt at vindicating the whole of Kant’s epistemology in the face of quantum mechanics. This attempt was made by Grete Hermann, a German neo-Kantian philosopher who spent several weeks with Heisenberg and Von Weiszäcker in 1935, trying to persuade them that the principle of causality could by no means be relinquished. Her claim was that it is always possible to reconstruct a causal chain a posteriori, even when (as it is the case in quantum mechanics) no predictive use of causality can be made. She then undertook a complete transcendental reinterpretation of quantum mechanics along the lines of the neo-Kantian psychology of J.F. Fries and L. Nelson.
zh: S. 布罗克首先描述康德与亥姆霍兹对玻尔思想和理论纲领的影响。当玻尔认为互补性作为客观知识的组织原理是“因果性理想”的推广时，就能看到这种影响。的确，按照玻尔的看法，因果性可以分析为两个互补的方面：“时空协调”与“动力学守恒定律”。在论文的后半部分，布罗克在卡西尔与玻尔的物理学观之间展开另一个（部分的）平行比较。康德与玻尔的物理学哲学之间的联系也是 H. 普林格一章的中心主题。这里的一个核心想法是：要理解这种联系，应当更多依靠《判断力批判》而不是《纯粹理性批判》。例如，当人们寻找（经典领域与量子领域之间的）经验类比时，玻尔的对应原理可以很容易地被看作反思性判断力的一条准则。至于互补性，它扮演“象征类比”的角色，即在无法把现象完全统一于单一对象图像之下的情形中，为对象提供双重象征化（作为波和作为微粒）的途径。L. 索莱尔随后研究面对量子力学为整个康德认识论辩护的最完备、最英勇的尝试之一。这一尝试由德国新康德主义哲学家格雷特·亨利-赫尔曼作出——她1935年与海森堡和冯·魏茨泽克共处数周，试图说服他们：因果性原理绝不可放弃。她的主张是：即便（如量子力学中的情形）无法对因果性作预测性使用，后天地重构一条因果链条总是可能的。她随后沿着 J. F. 弗里斯和 L. 纳尔逊的新康德主义心理学路线，对量子力学进行了完整的先验重新解释。

en: At this point we focus on some ideas that can be used to make sense of recent developments of quantum physics in the framework of transcendental epistemology.
zh: 在这一点上，我们聚焦于一些可在先验认识论框架内用来理解量子物理学近期发展的思想。

en: M. Bitbol first develops a transcendental reading of decoherence theories. He presents it as a middle way between the usual realist reading and a strictly empiricist reading. According to realist philosophers, the macro-world is a mere appearance arising from quantum reality by way of decoherence. And according to empiricist philosophers, only macroscopic experimental outcomes are real, whereas the quantum formalism is only a predictive symbolism. But for a transcendental philosopher, both readings are biased. The first one is biased in favor of formal theoretical constructs taken as descriptive of a putative reality more real than phenomena; whereas the second one is biased in favor of phenomena, thus forgetting that phenomena only acquire their meaning from the formalism in which they are embedded. Along with the transcendental middle way, decoherence is situated in a two-step scheme of constitution of objectivity appropriate for quantum mechanics. S. Osnaghi then attempts a radical move indispensible to a transcendental construal of quantum mechanics. He shows that in the framework of this theory, one must conceive objectivity without (individual) objects. He also addresses the issue of decoherence, undertaking to dismantle its realist reading by way of a careful analysis of quantum entanglement, as illustrated by QED-cavity experiments. With G. Catren’s chapter, we are presented with the deepest formal operations of constitution of objects, applied to quantum theories. Here, objective properties are defined as transformations, and constrained to be automorphism. However, the most crucial condition is imposed not on each property taken in isolation but on a set of properties: if they are to be taken as properties of one and the same object, each one of them must be invariant with respect to the transformations associated to the other properties of the same set. This condition is found to be extremely discriminative. It allows one to interpret Heisenberg’s uncertainty principle as an expression of the much more general fact that not all the spatio-kinematic properties can be simultaneously objective. Retrospectively, it then appears that classical mechanics went astray by wrongly considering certain properties as simultaneously objective. In view of this rigorous analysis of the constitution of objective properties, quantum mechanics is complete, whereas classical mechanics is misleadingly overabundant.
zh: M. 比托尔首先展开对退相干理论的一种先验解读。他把它呈现为通常的实在论解读与严格经验论解读之间的中间道路。按照实在论哲学家的看法，宏观世界只是经由退相干从量子实在中产生的显象。而按照经验论哲学家的看法，只有宏观实验结果是实在的，量子形式体系则只是一种预测性符号体系。但对先验哲学家来说，两种解读都有偏向。第一种偏向于把形式的理论构造物当作对某种比现象更实在的假定实在的描述；第二种则偏向于现象，从而忘记了现象只有从其所嵌入的形式体系中获得意义。沿着这条先验中间道路，退相干被安置在适合量子力学的两步客观性构成图式之中。S. 奥斯纳吉随后尝试对量子力学的先验理解不可或缺的一个激进举措。他表明，在这一理论的框架内，必须设想没有（个体）对象的客观性。他还处理退相干问题，通过对量子纠缠的细致分析（以腔量子电动力学实验为例）来拆解其实在论解读。在 G. 卡特伦的一章中，我们看到应用于量子理论的最深刻的对象构成形式运算。在这里，客观属性被定义为变换，并被约束为自同构。然而，最关键的条件不是加于孤立看待的每个属性，而是加于一组属性：如果它们要被视为同一个对象的属性，其中每一个都必须相对于与同一组中其他属性相联系的变换保持不变。这一条件被发现具有极强的甄别力。它使人能够把海森堡不确定性原理解释为一个远为一般的事实的表达：并非所有空间—运动学属性都能同时是客观的。回溯地看，于是显出经典力学误入歧途：它错误地把某些属性视为同时客观的。鉴于这种对客观属性构成的严格分析，量子力学是完备的，而经典力学则承认了过多的客观属性，因而容易造成误解。

en: But beyond Relativity and Quantum Mechanics, there are many modern theories which aim at broadening their scope by unifying them as far as possible. These theories are also liable to a transcendental interpretation.
zh: 但在相对论与量子力学之外，还有许多现代理论力求尽可能统一二者，由此拓展它们的适用范围。这些理论同样可以接受先验解释。

en: I.O. Stamatescu adopts a thoroughly Cassirerian pattern of analysis: here, one is concerned by the evolution of “symbolic forms”, as needed by the development of modern physics. Objectivation is thus conceived as a dynamical process expanding across the history of physics. This idea is especially applied to the issue of the successive redefinitions of a standard object of microphysics such as the electron. Then, H.G. Dosch applies a similar Cassirerian outlook to our understanding of particle physics and quantum field theories. Here, the creative aspect of the construction of the standard model of particle physics is highlighted, and it is pointed out that the large amount of freedom of this creative process can hardly be accounted for by a realist construal of physics. Finally, J. Petitot provides a detailed transcendental analysis of one of the most important proposals for unifying General Relativity and Quantum Theories: Noncommutative Geometry (NCG). He starts from a conception of constitution of objectivity as mathematical construction of categories. Then, he points out that, in general Relativity and quantum field theories, symmetry groups enable one to construct mathematically both the physical content of the categories of substance and the physical content of the categories of force and interaction. This procedure is then extended to NCG, which introduces quantum concepts in the very definition of geometry. Equivalents in NCG of every single step of Kant’s transcendental analysis of classical mechanics in the Metaphysical Foundations of Natural Science, from phoronomy to phenomenology, are provided.
zh: I. O. 斯塔马泰斯库采用彻底卡西尔式的分析样式：这里关注的是“象征形式”随现代物理学发展所需的演化。客观化于是被设想为一个在物理学史中不断扩展的动态过程。这一想法被特别应用于微观物理学标准对象（例如电子）的历次重新定义问题。随后，H. G. 多施把类似的卡西尔式视角应用于我们对粒子物理学和量子场论的理解。这里突出了粒子物理学标准模型建构的创造性方面，并指出这一创造过程的大量自由很难由物理学的实在论理解来说明。最后，J. 珀蒂托对统一广义相对论与量子理论的最重要方案之一——非交换几何（NCG）——提供详细的先验分析。他从把客观性的构成理解为范畴的数学构造这一构想出发。然后他指出，在广义相对论和量子场论中，对称群使人能够在数学上既构造实体范畴的物理内容，也构造力与相互作用范畴的物理内容。这一程序随后被扩展到NCG——它把量子概念引入几何学的定义本身。康德在《自然科学的形而上学初始根据》中对经典力学的先验分析的每一步，从运动学到现象学，都在NCG中给出了对应物。

en: But this book would have been incomplete without some dissonant voices, and without the opportunity to confront transcendental epistemology with alternative epistemologies, from constructive empiricism to realism.
zh: 但如果没有一些不和谐的声音，没有机会让先验认识论与从建构经验论到实在论的另类认识论对质，这本书就不完整。

en: B. Van Fraassen first carefully specifies the terms of the debate between constructive empiricism and transcendentalism. Both doctrines reject metaphysics, but at the same time each one of them appear to the other as deceitfully engaging into the rejected metaphysics. As seen from an empiricist standpoint, transcendentalism appears to grant too much to a metaphysics of the knowing subject, whereas as seen from a transcendentalist standpoint, empiricism appears to make too many concessions to transcendent realism (though with a strong dose of agnosticism about “reality out there”). Van Fraassen then undertakes to meet the standard transcendentalist objection that he formulates thus: “It does not make sense to say that there could be things that are not describable (in our language in use) and hence not knowable, and thus also certainly not known”. His residual realism is aknowledged by him, but carefully distinguished from any metaphysical version of it that could be criticized by a transcendentalist. This empiricist variety of realism only amounts to accepting that describing scientific activity (and scientific product) de facto involves common sense realism. B. d’Espagnat then undertakes a nuanced defense of realism from the standpoint of a practicing physicist. He accepts that modern physics (especially quantum physics) represents a fatal blow to any direct realist epistemology claiming that physics is meant to describe reality as it is. But at the same time, he rejects the extreme neo-Kantian view according to which any discourse about the “thing in itself” is meaningless. He rather sticks to a position similar to Kant’s original conception, for reasons he draws from a detailed discussion of the meaning of quantum theories. H. Lyre then offers a systematic defense of structural realism against epistemic structuralism and ontic realism, yet basing this defense on transcendental arguments. He illustrates his point by discussing the status of Gauge theories. P. Teller finally ponders about what we add to (or what we tend to withdraw from) empirical knowledge when we frame theories and explanatory strategies. If we want neither to stick to empiricist agnosticism, nor to accept a transcendental interpretation of this added structure as a condition of possibility of experience, we must wonder about its status. Is the added material merely a distortion, or can it sometimes count as (provisional) knowledge (of some external reality)?
zh: B. 范·弗拉森首先仔细厘清建构经验论与先验论争论的要点。两种学说都拒斥形而上学，但同时在对方看来，各自都在暗中引入自己所拒斥的形而上学。从经验论立场看，先验论似乎对认识主体的形而上学让步太多；而从先验论立场看，经验论似乎对超验实在论作了太多妥协（尽管对“外面的实在”带有强烈的不可知论色彩）。范·弗拉森随后着手回应标准的先验论反驳，他把它表述如下：“说可能存在（用我们现行语言）不可描述、因而不可认识、从而也肯定未被认识的事物，是没有意义的。”他承认自己的残余实在论，但把它与任何可能受先验论者批评的形而上学版本仔细区分开来。这种经验论式的实在论只在于承认：描述科学活动（及科学产品）事实上涉及常识实在论。B. 德·埃斯帕尼亚随后从一位从业物理学家的立场出发，对实在论作出细致的辩护。他承认现代物理学（尤其是量子物理学）对任何声称物理学旨在如其所是地描述实在的直接实在论认识论是致命一击。但他同时拒斥那种认为任何关于“物自身”的话语都无意义的极端新康德主义观点。他毋宁坚持一种类似于康德原初构想的立场，其理由来自他对量子理论意义的详细讨论。H. 吕雷随后为结构实在论提供系统辩护，反对认识论结构主义与本体实在论，却把这一辩护建立在先验论证之上。他通过讨论规范理论的地位来例示自己的观点。P. 特勒最后沉思：当我们构建理论和解释策略时，我们给经验知识添加了什么（或倾向于从中撤回什么）。如果我们既不想坚持经验论的不可知论，也不想接受把这种添加结构视为经验可能性条件的先验解释，就必须追问它的地位。添加的材料只是一种扭曲，还是有时可以算作（关于某种外部实在的）（暂定）知识？
